papers.title: Correlation-Consistent Gaussian Basis Sets for Periodic Solids. I. Hydrogen and p-block Elements from Boron to Chlorine
papers.abstract: We present the cc-pVXZ-s series (X = D, T, and Q) of correlation-consistent Gaussian basis sets for solids, covering hydrogen and the p-block elements from boron to chlorine. The series includes basis sets of consistent quality for the all-electron potential and for various pseudopotentials and effective core potentials commonly used in periodic calculations. Our design combines Dunning's construction of the molecular cc-pVXZ series with a revised material-constrained atomic optimization (MCAO) algorithm for improved numerical performance. MCAO regularizes standard atomic optimization to suppress overly diffuse basis functions and ensure numerical stability in a set of reference solids. Benchmarks against standard cc-pVXZ calculations for molecules and plane-wave calculations for periodic solids establish the accuracy, transferability, and numerical stability of cc-pVXZ-s in both mean-field and correlated wavefunction calculations and confirm reliable extrapolation to the complete-basis-set (CBS) limit. As an application, we use all-electron cc-pVXZ-s to compute basis-set-converged lattice constants, bulk moduli, and cohesive energies for 7 bulk semiconductors. Using a hierarchy of correlated wavefunction methods up to local coupled cluster with singles, doubles, and perturbative triples [CCSD(T)], we find systematic convergence toward experimental bulk moduli and cohesive energies, while a small systematic overestimation of lattice constants suggests potential limitations in the approximate finite-size treatment. This work provides a foundation for the further development of systematically convergent Gaussian basis sets for periodic calculations.

研究问题：如何为周期固体构建兼顾数值稳定性和相关一致性的高斯基组，并验证其精度与CBS外推可靠性？
证据与比较：与分子标准cc-pVXZ计算和周期固体平面波计算进行基准比较；对7种体相半导体用全电子cc-pVXZ-s计算基组收敛的晶格常数、体模量和内聚能，并采用至CCSD(T)的相关波函数方法层级。

papers.title: SunLightBots: Turning sunlight into self-sustained, high-power motion in soft robots
papers.abstract: Soft robots built from active materials can directly convert environmental stimuli into motion, offering a route to energy autonomy and embodied control. However, environmental energy is generally harvested at low power, whereas rapid, mechanically demanding actions require high mechanical output power. Reconciling this mismatch while sustaining self-regulated cyclic actuation is challenging, particularly at the subgram scale, where limited payload capacity constrains the integration of conventional power and control hardware. Here, we present SunLightBots, a class of subgram, sunlight-powered, untethered soft robots that achieve autonomous locomotion under continuous illumination near 1 Sun (100 mW/cm2). Their operation is enabled by a self-resetting snapping (SRS) mechanism that integrates liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) with snap-through instability to accumulate solar energy supplied at low power, release it as rapid, high-power motion, and reset through photothermal-mechanical feedback. Through coordinated optimization of the LCE actuation temperature, photothermal conversion, actuation stress, and structural energy barrier, the system operates near 1 Sun and achieves a peak mass-specific mechanical power of 89 W/kg. At this irradiance, the optimized LCE generates an actuation stress of 0.1 MPa at approximately 60 deg C. SunLightBots demonstrate sustained swimming, crawling, and repeated impulsive jumping. Under 1.5 Suns, the swimmer advances more than three body lengths per cycle. This work provides a materials-mechanics route toward autonomous soft robots powered entirely by the environment.

papers.title: Emergent Anyons in a Weakly Interacting Gauged Chern Insulator
papers.abstract: We derive a microscopic relation between the many-body Chern number $C$ of the fermionic ground state and the braiding of fluxes in $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ gauge theory coupled to matter: under a spectral gap condition, dressed flux loops obey $W_2W_1=e^{i\fracπ{2}C}W_1W_2$ on the ground-state sector. We realize $C=1$ by gauging charge parity in a weakly interacting Qi-Wu-Zhang insulator. Reflection positivity and chessboard estimates show that flux defects are massive, which yields a gapped, topologically ordered phase with four locally indistinguishable ground states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；推导微观关系并构造模型；研究对象：弱相互作用Qi-Wu-Zhang绝缘体中的Z₂规范理论
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 费米基态多体Chern数C与Z₂规范理论中磁通编织满足W₂W₁=e^{iπC/2}W₁W₂，C=1时得到四重简并的拓扑有序相。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：多体Chern数与Z₂规范理论中磁通编织之间是否存在微观联系，以及规范化后能否产生有能隙的拓扑有序相。
证据与比较：在能隙条件下推导基态扇区的编织关系；反射正性与棋盘估计表明磁通缺陷有质量，给出四个局域不可区分基态。

papers.title: Quantum synchronization in XX chains under relaxation
papers.abstract: We study stable synchronization in qubit XX chains with site-dependent frequencies and exchange couplings under multi-local amplitude damping noise, extending the uniform-chain results of B. Çakmak et al., [Phys. Rev. A 114, L030202 2026] in several directions. We establish that the dark-mode energies are precisely the eigenvalues shared by all undamped segments separated by the damped sites. Generic stable synchronization of the edge qubits occurs if and only if these segments share exactly one eigenvalue and this eigenvalue is nonzero, in which case every qubit on the support of the corresponding dark mode is synchronized with locking constants independent of the initial preparation. This spectral matching condition identifies the Hamiltonian parameters that support synchronization, while the couplings to the damped sites control the relative oscillation amplitudes. We present analytical examples which show how inhomogeneity can create synchronization absent in uniform chains and turn preparation-dependent locking into generic synchronization. We also calculate the asymptotic pairwise concurrence and prove that, in the single-dark-mode regime, every pair participating in synchronized oscillations remains entangled with a nonzero, constant concurrence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于开放量子系统解析推导；研究对象：位点依赖频率与交换耦合的量子比特XX链，受多局域振幅阻尼噪声
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 边缘量子比特的稳定同步当且仅当被阻尼位点分隔的各无阻尼段恰好共享一个非零本征值时发生，且该本征值即暗模能量。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在非均匀XX链与多局域振幅阻尼下，何种谱匹配条件决定边缘量子比特能否实现与初态无关的稳定同步。
证据与比较：摘要给出谱匹配条件的解析论证，并给出解析示例说明非均匀性可产生均匀链所无的同步、将依赖初态的锁定转为普适同步；还计算渐近两两concurrence（纠缠度量），证明单暗模情形下参与同步振荡的每对量子比特保持非零恒定concurrence。
papers.method_zh: 开放量子系统框架下的解析谱分析与暗模分析，辅以解析示例和渐近concurrence计算。

english_guide.question: Which spectral matching condition governs generic, preparation-independent stable synchronization in inhomogeneous qubit XX chains under multi-local amplitude damping?
english_guide.evidence: Analytical arguments establish the spectral matching condition; analytical examples show inhomogeneity creates synchronization absent in uniform chains and turns preparation-dependent locking into generic synchronization; asymptotic pairwise concurrence is computed, proving nonzero constant concurrence in the single-dark-mode regime.
english_guide.method: Analytical spectral and dark-mode analysis within open quantum systems, with analytical examples and asymptotic concurrence calculations.

papers.title: Squeezed Light Generation by Cooper Pair Recombination in a Superconductor-Semiconductor Structure
papers.abstract: We theoretically demonstrate squeezed light generation in a compact, electrically driven device utilizing the nonlinear light-matter interaction of Cooper-pair recombination in a hybrid superconductorsemiconductor structure. On the basis of second-order perturbation theory, we developed an effective Hamiltonian which incorporates the electronic component of the interaction as a photon coupling strength coefficient, enabling a model to describe the quadrature squeezing effect of Cooper-pair recombination on the photonic state. We find the squeezing strength to be proportional to the superconducting energy gap squared and device length, as well as increasing with applied voltage. For practical device length, materials and voltage bias, we calculated squeezing values comparable to those of existing squeezed light generation methods when operating below the critical temperature. This theoretically developed concept shows viability for electrically pumped squeezed light generation and can pave the way towards realization of squeezing in compact integrated structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于二阶微扰理论构建有效哈密顿量；研究对象：超导体-半导体异质结构中的库珀对复合过程
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 库珀对复合可在电驱动紧凑器件中产生压缩光，压缩强度正比于超导能隙平方与器件长度，并随外加电压增大。

研究问题：能否利用超导体-半导体结构中库珀对复合的非线性光-物质相互作用，实现电驱动的压缩光产生？
证据与比较：基于二阶微扰理论推导有效哈密顿量，将电子相互作用部分作为光子耦合强度系数；给出压缩强度与超导能隙平方、器件长度成正比，并随电压增大；对实际器件长度、材料和偏压计算得到与现有压缩光方法相当的压缩值（低于临界温度时）。

english_guide.question: Can the nonlinear light-matter interaction of Cooper-pair recombination in a hybrid superconductor-semiconductor structure enable electrically pumped squeezed light generation?

english_guide.method: Second-order perturbation theory to derive an effective Hamiltonian modeling quadrature squeezing of the photonic state by Cooper-pair recombination.
english_guide.novelty: The authors claim a theoretically developed concept for electrically pumped squeezed light generation in compact integrated structures.
english_guide.limitations: Abstract does not specify material system, device parameters, or quantitative squeezing values; conclusions are theoretical without experimental verification.

papers.title: Probing Krylov Dynamics in Driven Many-Body Systems
papers.abstract: Krylov complexity has become a central probe of operator growth, scrambling, and quantum chaos. Yet, a basic fact hinders its experimental study: laboratory quantum systems are routinely driven in time, whereas the Krylov construction assumes a fixed generator and breaks down once the Hamiltonian varies. Here, we solve the time-dependent many-body Krylov problem exactly and in closed form for scale- and rotation-invariant systems realized in current quantum-simulation and control platforms. We find exact relations that map the driven dynamics onto mutually orthogonal Krylov subspaces and yield a closed-form spread complexity, determined solely by the spectral properties of the initial Hamiltonian and the driving schedule. The construction extends to Liouville space and solves the time-dependent density-matrix Krylov problem, which makes the Krylov dynamics of initial thermal states experimentally accessible. In scale-invariant quantum gases, such as the driven Lieb-Liniger model, the Tonks-Girardeau gas, and the Calogero-Sutherland model, the complexity is set by the width of the atomic cloud and its rate of change, directly accessible via in situ and time-of-flight imaging. In rotation-invariant spin systems such as the Haldane-Shastry and central-spin models, it is governed by collective spin precession that can be probed and read out in trapped-ion, cavity-QED, and circuit-QED platforms.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 含时驱动多体系统的Krylov问题可精确闭式求解，驱动动力学映射到相互正交的Krylov子空间，扩展复杂度仅由初始哈密顿量谱性质与驱动方案决定。

研究问题：Krylov构造假设生成元固定，哈密顿量随时间变化时失效；如何为实验常规驱动的量子系统建立含时多体Krylov描述？
证据与比较：摘要给出精确闭式关系，将驱动动力学映射到相互正交的Krylov子空间并得到闭式扩展复杂度；构造推广至Liouville空间并求解含时密度矩阵Krylov问题；未提供数值或实验数据。

english_guide.evidence: Exact closed-form relations mapping driven dynamics onto mutually orthogonal Krylov subspaces and a closed-form spread complexity; extension to Liouville space solving the time-dependent density-matrix Krylov problem; no numerical or experimental data are provided.

english_guide.novelty: The authors claim an exact closed-form solution of the time-dependent many-body Krylov problem and an extension to Liouville space making Krylov dynamics of initial thermal states experimentally accessible.

papers.title: The bias interval of the elephant random walk
papers.abstract: Guérin, Laulin, Raschel, and Simon conjectured that the initial biases giving the superdiffusive elephant random walk a bimodal limit law form an interval centered at one half, and they described the problem as challenging. We prove this. For every superdiffusive memory, strongly biased starts are unimodal, and the limit density has two local maxima exactly when the bias lies in a proper open interval. Outside it, including its endpoints, the density has a unique local maximum. The interval is nonempty exactly above a single memory threshold, numerically about $0.6688$, whose uniqueness follows from a positive-weight integral for the central curvature of the fair-start density. We control sign changes in the finite walk's first and second differences, including those created at the boundary, and pass them to the limit. The bias boundary is continuous and tends to zero at least quadratically fast as memory tends to one.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；判断依据：摘要为数学证明，无实验或数值模拟数据；研究对象：象随机游走（elephant random walk）的初始偏置与极限密度
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明超扩散象随机游走的双峰极限律对应一个以1/2为中心的偏置区间，该区间非空当且仅当记忆参数超过约0.6688的阈值。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：验证Guérin、Laulin、Raschel与Simon提出的猜想：使超扩散象随机游走具有双峰极限律的初始偏置是否构成以1/2为中心的区间。
证据与比较：摘要给出：区间外及端点处密度仅有一个局部极大；区间非空恰在单一记忆阈值之上，数值约0.6688，其唯一性由公平起点密度中心曲率的正权重积分推出；偏置边界连续，记忆趋于1时至少二次速度趋于零。
papers.method_zh: 控制有限步游走一阶与二阶差分的符号变化（含边界产生者）并取极限，结合中心曲率的正权重积分。

english_guide.finding: The bimodal limit law of the superdiffusive elephant random walk corresponds to a bias interval centered at one half, nonempty exactly above a memory threshold numerically about 0.6688.
english_guide.question: Whether the initial biases yielding a bimodal limit law form an interval centered at one half, as conjectured by Guérin, Laulin, Raschel, and Simon.
english_guide.evidence: Outside the interval and at its endpoints the density has a unique local maximum; the interval is nonempty exactly above a single memory threshold, numerically about 0.6688, whose uniqueness follows from a positive-weight integral for the central curvature of the fair-start density; the bias boundary is continuous and tends to zero at least quadratically as memory tends to one.
english_guide.method: Control sign changes in the finite walk's first and second differences, including those created at the boundary, and pass them to the limit, combined with a positive-weight integral for the central curvature.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state they prove a problem described as challenging, establishing the bimodal interval and the memory threshold for its nonemptiness with uniqueness.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify the scope or regularity assumptions of the proof; the threshold 0.6688 is numerical and no rigorous error bound is stated.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称证明了一个此前被描述为具有挑战性的猜想，并给出双峰区间非空的记忆阈值及其唯一性。

papers.title: Rotor-driven piecewise cross polarization of wide quadrupolar lines: bath-contact pumping of vector and tensor order in dynamically polarized solids
papers.abstract: In a dynamically polarized solid with a common nuclear spin temperature, spin-1 $^{14}$N in ammonia sits at $P_N\simeq0.14$ when the protons are at $0.90$, and a deuteron in a proton-rich matrix at $P_D\simeq0.29$. Hartmann--Hahn cross polarization (CP) from the protons could raise either toward $P_H$, but the first-order quadrupole interaction spreads the $^{14}$N line over $5$~MHz at $5$~T, far beyond any single contact bandwidth. We develop the theory of CP into one transition of a quadrupolar spin-1, with slow sample rotation carrying each crystallite through a fixed-frequency contact window. A bath contact is an idempotent map on the populations of the contacted transition, so repeated or continuous contacts accumulate rather than cancel, and the hit-once and parity constraints that force stepped rotation for pulsed inversions do not arise. In the small-reservoir limit the population ratio across the contacted transition becomes $(1+P_H)/(1-P_H)$, giving $\Pzz=+0.88$ in one contact and $\Pzz\to-1.8$ in two from $P_H=0.9$, beyond the unitary bound $[-0.85,+0.65]$. Under continuous rotation, a window at the Pake horn reaches every bond for an axis perpendicular to the field, while a window in the clean pedestal region, needed for a definite sign of tensor order, reaches a fraction $\sin2θ_c=0.943$ at the magic angle $54.74\degree$. Steady-state order is set by the contact rate against rotation-driven cross-branch relaxation, negligible for $^{14}$N. In the cubic limit one contact places the spin-1 at the proton temperature ($\Pzz=+0.85$), but only a resolved quadrupole splitting permits negative tensor order. The limiting resource is the proton spin lock, which must far exceed the $\simeq28$~kHz local field for a contact short compared with $T_{1ρ}$, unmeasured at $1$~K. Protocols are given for $^{14}$N in NH$_3$ and deuterons in NH$_2$D.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；摘要提出CP理论框架，未报告实验；研究对象：动态极化固体中的自旋-1 ¹⁴N（氨）与氘核（富质子基质），5 T下四极展宽约5 MHz
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 转子驱动的分段交叉极化可把四极跃迁布居比推至(1+P_H)/(1-P_H)，使Pzz超出幺正界限，但负张量序需可分辨四极劈裂。

研究问题：如何用交叉极化把宽四极线的自旋-1核极化提升到质子自旋温度，并克服单次接触带宽远小于5 MHz展宽的限制。
证据与比较：摘要给出P_N≈0.14、P_D≈0.29、P_H=0.9；单次接触Pzz=+0.88、两次→−1.8，对比幺正界[−0.85,+0.65]；魔角54.74°下sin2θ_c=0.943；¹⁴N交叉支弛豫可忽略。
papers.method_zh: 建立自旋-1单一跃迁的Hartmann–Hahn CP理论，用慢速样品旋转使各微晶通过固定频率接触窗，并分析连续/重复接触与稳态序。

english_guide.finding: Rotor-driven piecewise cross polarization can drive the contacted-transition population ratio to (1+P_H)/(1-P_H), giving Pzz=+0.88 in one contact and approaching -1.8 in two from P_H=0.9, beyond the unitary bound [-0.85,+0.65].
english_guide.question: How can cross polarization raise the polarization of spin-1 nuclei with wide quadrupolar lines toward the proton spin temperature when the 5 MHz 14N line exceeds any single contact bandwidth?
english_guide.evidence: The abstract gives P_N≈0.14, P_D≈0.29 and P_H=0.9; Pzz=+0.88 after one contact and →-1.8 after two versus the unitary bound; sin2θ_c=0.943 at the magic angle 54.74°; cross-branch relaxation negligible for 14N.
english_guide.method: Theory of Hartmann–Hahn CP into one transition of a quadrupolar spin-1, with slow sample rotation carrying each crystallite through a fixed-frequency contact window; analysis of repeated or continuous contacts and steady-state order.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that a bath contact is an idempotent map on the populations of the contacted transition, so repeated or continuous contacts accumulate rather than cancel, and the hit-once and parity constraints of pulsed inversions do not arise.
english_guide.limitations: Valid in the small-reservoir and cubic limits; the proton spin lock must far exceed the ≃28 kHz local field for a contact short compared with T1ρ, which the abstract says is unmeasured at 1 K.

papers.title: Hands-on fabrication of 2D material field-effect transistors for the classroom using off-the-shelf ionic gel
papers.abstract: We introduce a hands-on experimental method that enables students to fabricate and operate van der Waals semiconductor-based field-effect transistors (FETs) using readily available materials and minimal infrastructure. The approach is based on ionic-gel gating using commercially available hydrogel conductors originally developed for muscle electrostimulation devices. For device fabrication we rely on commercially available thin-film interdigitated electrode arrays and for the semiconductor channel, we deposited MoS2 flakes produced by high-throughput mechanical exfoliation. By avoiding the need for cleanroom processing, vacuum deposition, or custom electrolytes, this method allows functional FETs based on van der Waals materials to be realized in a standard teaching laboratory. The experiment is well suited for undergraduate and early graduate courses and is intended to complement concepts introduced in electronics and solid-state physics by providing students with first-hand experience in the fabrication and electrical characterization of emerging electronic devices. Representative electrical measurements demonstrate gate-dependent modulation of the channel conductance and illustrate characteristic features of ionic-gated transistor operation. Overall, the proposed platform provides an accessible route for students to fabricate, characterize, and analyze field-effect devices without access to conventional semiconductor foundry.

papers.title: Universal Critical Relations and Nonuniversal Scaling in Inverse-Square Ising Chains
papers.abstract: For ferromagnetic Ising chains with $n^2J_n\to B>0$, the critical excess magnetization in a field inversely proportional to spin separation determines the connected correlation. Their slowly varying profile has finite logarithmic integral exactly when the ordered thermal slope is finite. For any finite nonnegative core, an exact tail gives inverse-logarithmic correlations and a square-root cusp. A relative correction $c/\log(n+e)$ with $c>1$ gives continuously varying logarithmic powers and a linear cusp. A lower bound on its disordered susceptibility excludes the usual Kosterlitz--Thouless law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于解析推导与精确尾部解；研究对象：逆平方伊辛链（inverse-square Ising chains），铁磁耦合满足 n²J_n→B>0
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 临界过量磁化决定连通关联；热斜率有限时慢变剖面具有有限对数积分，并给出逆对数关联与平方根尖点。

研究问题：在 n²J_n→B>0 的铁磁伊辛链中，临界过量磁化如何决定连通关联及其剖面与尖点行为？
证据与比较：摘要给出精确尾部结果：任意有限非负核下得到逆对数关联与平方根尖点；相对修正 c/log(n+e)（c>1）给出连续变化的对数幂与线性尖点；并给出无序磁化率下界。

papers.title: Fast Accurate Quantum Monte Carlo without Metropolis Adjustment
papers.abstract: In quantum systems, physical quantities of interest can be expressed as expectation values of a probability distribution, which allows their estimation by Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. This approach, an instance of Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC), plays a central role in obtaining predictions of system properties relevant to condensed matter and high energy physics. The use of Hamiltonian dynamics to design a Markov kernel, known as Hybrid or Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC), is widespread in quantum applications. In this context, it is standard to use an HMC kernel that is ``adjusted'' with the Metropolis-Hastings (MH) criterion, so that estimates of expectations converge to their true value in the limit of infinite sample size. However, recent work in computational statistics suggests that an \emph{unadjusted} HMC kernel can be significantly more efficient, while safely maintaining an asymptotic bias which is small relative to the error arising from the variance of the finite sample size. We adapt this approach to the QMC setting, focusing on a challenging and high-dimensional \emph{spin-fermion} model of a quantum phase transition. We find that unadjusted methods outperform adjusted HMC in terms of effective sample size per gradient call, while retaining accurate results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算物理研究；基于摘要对HMC核的数值比较；研究对象：量子相变的自旋-费米子（spin-fermion）模型，高维量子多体体系
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子相变自旋-费米子模型中，未调整（unadjusted）HMC核在每次梯度调用的有效样本量上优于经Metropolis-Hastings调整的HMC，同时保持结果准确。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否将计算统计中无需Metropolis-Hastings调整的HMC核迁移到量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）场景，并在高维自旋-费米子模型上兼顾效率与精度？
证据与比较：摘要报告在自旋-费米子量子相变模型上比较了未调整与调整HMC，指标为每次梯度调用的有效样本量（effective sample size per gradient call），并称未调整方法更优且结果保持准确；未给出具体数值、误差或渐近偏置的定量估计。
papers.method_zh: 采用哈密顿动力学构造马尔可夫核的混合/哈密顿蒙特卡罗（HMC），在QMC框架下比较未调整核与Metropolis-Hastings调整核。

english_guide.finding: Unadjusted HMC kernels outperform Metropolis-Hastings-adjusted HMC in effective sample size per gradient call while retaining accurate results in a spin-fermion quantum phase transition model.
english_guide.question: Can an unadjusted HMC kernel from computational statistics be adapted to quantum Monte Carlo and remain efficient and accurate in a high-dimensional spin-fermion setting?
english_guide.evidence: The abstract compares unadjusted and adjusted HMC on a spin-fermion quantum phase transition model using effective sample size per gradient call, reporting better performance for the unadjusted method with accurate results; no numerical values or quantitative bias bounds are given.
english_guide.method: Hybrid/Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) using Hamiltonian dynamics to design a Markov kernel, comparing unadjusted kernels with Metropolis-Hastings-adjusted kernels in the QMC setting.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state they adapt the unadjusted HMC approach to the QMC setting and demonstrate its efficiency advantage on a challenging high-dimensional spin-fermion quantum phase transition model.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract covers only a specific spin-fermion model; the unadjusted kernel has an asymptotic bias claimed to be small relative to finite-sample variance error, but no quantitative bound is provided; applicability to other models or parameter regimes is not stated.

papers.title: Mutual Linearity in Nonlinear Population Dynamics
papers.abstract: Mutual Linearity in Nonlinear Population DynamicsMutual linearity, the persistence of affine relations among stationary observables under arbitrarily strong changes of one transition rate, is known for Markov jump processes and chemical reaction networks. We show that generalized Lotka--Volterra dynamics form a new class of mutually linear systems, even though species can go extinct and attractors can be chaotic. Any change to one species' equation acts on the others as one effective press and keeps all abundances affinely related: piecewise across extinctions, and as time averages on chaotic attractors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于广义 Lotka–Volterra 动力学的解析推导；研究对象：广义 Lotka–Volterra 动力学（generalized Lotka–Volterra dynamics）中的多物种群落
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 广义 Lotka–Volterra 动力学构成一类新的互线性（mutual linearity）系统：改变单一物种方程会对其余物种产生一个有效压变（effective press），并使所有丰度保持仿射关系。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：互线性此前已知于马尔可夫跳跃过程与化学反应网络，本文考察广义 Lotka–Volterra 动力学是否也具备互线性，以及物种灭绝与混沌吸引子下该性质是否仍成立。
证据与比较：摘要为理论论证，未给出具体数值、模拟或实验数据；所述证据为：任意强度改变一个跃迁速率后，稳态可观测量间仿射关系持续存在，且在灭绝处分段成立、在混沌吸引子上以时间平均形式成立。

papers.title: The active chiral random walk
papers.abstract: We introduce a minimal and intuitive lattice model for an active chiral particle which exhibits persistence, reversal, and chirality in its dynamics. It is fully defined by a small set of microscopic parameters that provide transparent control over the resulting dynamics. By coarse-graining, we extract continuum equations and closed-form expressions for the velocity autocorrelation, off-diagonal directional correlation, mean-squared displacement, and long-time diffusion and odd diffusion coefficients. The complex parameter $λ=q_p+\mathrm{i}q_c$ thereby encodes the microscopic information on persistence ($q_p$) and chirality ($q_c$) of the walker. In a weak-turning limit, microscopically realized by infrequent reorientation events, the continuum description can be mapped onto well-established models of active matter. Outside this limit the discrete model exhibits finite-step dynamics, such as anti-persistent motion, that are not captured by a smooth angular-diffusion description. The model therefore provides a compact, exactly solvable, and readily tunable framework in which a small number of transparent microscopic parameters control chiral active transport.

papers.title: Dimensional Crossover and Correlated Spin Dynamics in the Chain-Like van der Waals Antiferromagnet AgCrP$_2$S$_6$
papers.abstract: We report a comprehensive investigation of the magnetic properties and spin dynamics of the chain-like van der Waals antiferromagnet AgCrP$_2$S$_6$ using magnetization, magnetic susceptibility, and $^{31}$P nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). The magnetic susceptibility exhibits a broad maximum near 250 K, characteristic of strong short-range antiferromagnetic correlations in a low-dimensional system. A classical Fisher-chain analysis gives an effective intrachain exchange scale $J/k_B\approx 140$ K, while a quantum $S=3/2$ nearest-neighbor-chain calculation yields $J/k_B\approx 114$ K. A constrained AF-FM zig-zag-chain calculation is also compatible with the susceptibility, supporting a dominant quasi one dimensional antiferromagnetic exchange scale of order 100 K. $^{31}$P NMR measurements provide microscopic insight into both static and dynamic spin correlations. The $K-χ$ relation displays two distinct linear regimes separated near $T^\ast\approx 250$ K, with different slopes indicating a change in the effective transferred hyperfine couplings. Below $T_{N}$, the relaxation follows $1/T_1\propto T^5$, consistent with magnon-mediated relaxation in the ordered state. The temperature dependence of the internal hyperfine field yields a critical exponent $β\approx 0.36$, consistent with three-dimensional universality. Together, these results establish AgCrP$_2$S$_6$ as a quasi-one-dimensional $S=3/2$ antiferromagnet embedded in a layered van der Waals host, in which local probes directly resolve the crossover from correlated intrachain spin dynamics to anisotropic three-dimensional magnetic order. More broadly, AgCrP$_2$S$_6$ provides a useful van der Waals platform for studying dimensional crossover, correlated spin dynamics, and hyperfine-coupling evolution in low-dimensional antiferromagnets.

papers.title: Tuning and Mapping of Two-Tone Optomechanical Instability up to the Physical Limits
papers.abstract: We report on the compete theory describing the two-tone instability proper to optomechanical back-action-evading experiments. We address all possible mistunings (including power imbalance of the two pumps), as well as the device imperfections (finite mechanical quality factor, and sideband resolution). We illustrate the importance of power mistuning and sideband resolution, the latter being particularly relevant in finding the back-action-evading "sweet spot". The model is compared to experiments performed up to an extremely high cooperativity, of almost a 100. This has been made possible thanks to a fine-tuning procedure, which is presented. The agreement theory-experiment is very good, and the limiting factor is unraveled: cavity frequency noise. Besides, we discover at very high drive powers new self-driven states, which all share the characteristic feature of presenting a mechanical comb spectrum; as if the synchronization of the responses to the two drives (which occurs at lower powers) was destroyed by nonlinear effects. We believe that our work is extremely relevant to the implementation of back-action-evading experiments, as well as other related two-tone schemes.

papers.title: Good Practices for Measuring the Interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction by Brillouin Light Scattering and Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect
papers.abstract: The interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (iDMI) is a key ingredient for stabilizing chiral magnetic states, such as skyrmions and chiral domain walls, which are key building blocks for next-generation spintronic technologies. Despite its importance, the quantitative determination of the iDMI constant, $D$, is often plagued by significant discrepancies. This paper establishes a set of good practices for measuring iDMI using two primary techniques: Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) and the Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect (MOKE). Through the analysis of Co/Pt-based heterostructures, this work provides a comprehensive roadmap for measurement procedures, data evaluation, and uncertainty analysis. Our analysis highlights the crucial role of magnetic parameters used to extract the iDMI constant and propagation of their uncertainties, and the measurement model for enhancing measurement reliability. The proposed methodology provides a practical framework for improving the consistency and reproducibility of iDMI measurements across different laboratories and experimental techniques.

papers.title: From Distribution of Extremes With Degradation to the Stress Redundancy Principle
papers.abstract: How a degradation source affects the statistics of the first among many identical independent stochastic particles to successfully reach a narrow target remains unclear. Here, we investigate the impact of degradation on the distributions of first-passage times and exit locations by exploiting the time-dependent fluxes associated with the corresponding Fokker-Planck equation. We also compute the escape probability by solving a mixed boundary value problem. In the large initial population $N_0$ limit, we derive an asymptotic formula for the mean first passage time associated with the fastest particle, revealing how the killing field modifies the classical $1/\log(N_0)$ scaling. However, when considering the population size at the time of the first exit, we obtain a specific dependency with respect to degradation, a phenomenon that we call the stress redundancy principle. For a degradation field restricted to a narrow subregion, we use an optimal control approach to derive the optimal trajectory where the fastest escape particles will be concentrated: interestingly, we report here that the optimal trajectories avoid the degradation area depending on killing intensity. Finally, we obtain analytical expressions for the distribution of first exit points along a narrow absorbing arc in two-dimensional regular domains. In addition, for a killing subregion tangent to the target boundary, our computations reveal how geometrical parameters influence the exit distribution. In summary, a killing source can significantly affect the statistics of the fastest diffusing particles, relevant for defining cellular and molecular time scales.

papers.title: Direction-Selective Anomalous Quantum Transport from Saddle-like Topological Surface States Coupled to an Electronic Instability in YbSb$_{2}$
papers.abstract: We report direction-selective anomalous quantum transport in epitaxial YbSb$_{2}$ thin films associated with an interplay between anisotropic topological surface states and an electronic instability. Quantum oscillations reveal a quasi-two-dimensional orbit with a non-trivial Berry phase and Dirac-like dispersion, observable for current along the $a$-axis but absent along the orthogonal in-plane $c$-axis. Together with first-principles calculations, these observations support its assignment to a saddle-like topological surface state. Its oscillation amplitude exhibits a field-dependent, non-monotonic temperature evolution that departs from conventional Lifshitz-Kosevich behavior. Raman and coherent phonon spectroscopy reveal additional low-temperature modes consistent with a density-wave instability. Their pronounced polarization anisotropy and colossal field-induced Raman enhancement suggest a strongly anisotropic, field-enhanced electronic susceptibility associated with the density-wave modes. Our findings point to dynamical coupling between anisotropic topological surface states and a field-responsive density-wave instability as a route to direction-selective anomalous quantum transport.

papers.title: Nonreciprocal Josephson Dynamics of a $\mathcal{PT}$-Symmetric Atomtronic SQUID
papers.abstract: We investigate non-Hermitian Josephson dynamics in an atomtronic quantum interference device (AQUID), formed by a ring Bose Einstein condensate with balanced atomic gain and loss regions and two moving optical barriers. The balanced gain and loss profile establishes a parity time symmetric potential while breaking spatial inversion symmetry, providing the essential ingredients for nonreciprocal Josephson transport. The dynamics are monitored nondestructively through the phase quadrature spectrum of an optomechanical cavity driven by Laguerre Gaussian beams coupled to the condensate. We demonstrate that increasing the local gain and loss strength softens the parity time symmetric collective mode towards an exceptional point, as verified by Bogoliubov de Gennes analysis. The associated coherent population exchange produces an additional characteristic splitting in the cavity output spectrum. For linearly translating barriers, non-Hermiticity provides an additional control parameter for tuning the critical current. When the barriers undergo simultaneous translation and rotation, the rotation induced phase modifies the interference between counter propagating currents, offering further control over the nonreciprocal response. Under periodic barrier modulation, we find more pronounced Shapiro steps in the current voltage characteristics due to the intrinsic parity time symmetric collective mode. Finally, we propose an alternative Hermitian realization using a tilted optical lattice, providing an experimentally accessible route to engineering biased transport and population transfer. Our results establish parity time symmetric atomtronic SQUIDs as a versatile platform for controlling nonreciprocal Josephson transport and collective excitations in driven quantum fluids.

papers.title: Edge quantum weight of finite Chern flakes and its topological floor
papers.abstract: The zero-point energy of an $LC$ circuit measures the polarization fluctuation of an insulator coupled to it. In a crystal this fluctuation is the bulk quantum weight $K_{\rm bulk}$, which the Chern number $C$ bounds below by $|C|$. We show that a finite Chern flake adds an edge term that survives as the flake grows. The low-frequency transitions of its chiral edge have squared dipole matrix elements that sum to an edge weight $K_{\rm edge}\ge |C|$ per unit area, a floor that follows from the positive absorption of both circular polarizations and the known cancellation of circular dichroism between edge and bulk. At weak coupling, which a growing flake eventually leaves, a circuit slower than the edge modes reads $K_{\rm bulk}+K_{\rm edge}$, averaged over two field directions, and a faster one approaches $K_{\rm bulk}$, so the reading depends on whether the flake is made large or the circuit slow first. In exact free-fermion calculations on lattice flakes with $|C|=1$ and 2 the summed circular dichroism of the edge sector extrapolates to $|C|$ in magnitude, so that the floor is $|C|$. Above the floor, each edge channel adds a number fixed by the boundary shape and its edge velocities, which square and rectangular lattice flakes with one channel follow to within 0.003, while the circular dichroism counts only the net chirality. The avoided crossing of the circuit with the edge mode gives the edge weight in units of the Hall conductance quantum, up to a geometric factor of the capacitor.

papers.title: Banding instabilities in poroelastic media under flow-driven compaction
papers.abstract: When cross-linked poroelastic media are subjected to a hydrostatic pressure difference, they compact, remaining fully swollen on their uppermost surface and becoming increasingly compressed with depth. A critical unexplored effect of cross-linking and resistance to shear deformation is investigated, which is not seen in classical models of poroelastic media treated as free elastic spheres, and resists the kind of compressive compaction that characterises these systems. Eventually, a steady-state profile dependent on osmotic, shear and transport properties is reached, supporting a uniform interstitial flow wherein the medium acts like a passive filter. In this paper, we show how these steady-state profiles are not necessarily stable, and propose a mechanism for the formation of instabilities, wherein some regions of the medium swell and others compact, forming distinctive horizontal or vertical banding patterns. In the latter case, these bands appear qualitatively to be higher-permeability conduits or channels, similar to wormholes or tunnels seen in granular media. It is possible to quantify the effect of changing the pressure head on the growth rate of instabilities and the separation lengthscale in this channelisation case, and how material properties like shear stiffness and dependence of permeability on porosity affect the dynamics of instability. Critically, it is shown that these instabilities are a fluid-mechanical effect, with an entirely new mechanism based on the porosity--permeability relationship and not on elastic effects. With an understanding of these mechanisms, we can derive insight into channelisation in poroelastic systems in geophysics, human biology and industry.

papers.title: From Growth to Devices: Oxygen-Controlled Superconductivity in BSCCO Thin Films
papers.abstract: Realizing device-compatible high-$T_c$ superconductors requires simultaneous control of oxygen stoichiometry and tolerance to nanofabrication. Here, we investigate sputtered Bi$_2$Sr$_2$Ca$_{n-1}$Cu$_n$O$_{2n+4+δ}$ (BSCCO) thin films and establish a direct link between annealing conditions, oxygen incorporation, and superconducting transport. By independently varying the annealing temperature and duration, we identify an optimal annealing condition of $860\,^{\circ}$C for 3\,h, which yields the highest superconducting transition temperature and the narrowest transition among the investigated samples. X-ray diffraction, electron microscopy, and X-ray photoemission spectroscopy reveal a non-monotonic evolution of lattice oxygen, which governs hole doping in the CuO$_2$ planes and produces the characteristic dome-like dependence of $T_c$ on doping concentration. We further translate these optimized films into micro-devices to assess fabrication-induced effects, via micro-bridges as well as a planar Josephson junction. We demonstrate devices fabricated via both lift-off and focused ion beam (FIB) patterning methods -- proving the fabrication compatibility of these films. Importantly, we demonstrate their air-stability for extended periods of time (2 months). The combined insights offer practical guidelines for integrating cuprate thin films into superconducting electronics and quantum device architectures.

papers.title: The Multiscale Principle in phase transition: Geometric structure, thermodynamic entropy, and dynamical instability
papers.abstract: Scaling and multi-scaling are two guiding principles for understanding nature or even commerce and industrial outcome. In the realm of critical phenomena, scaling laws describe the behavior of physical quantities near a continuous phase transition. This is a complex phenomena where systems exhibit critical fluctuations and long-range correlations, challenging classical formulations such as the fluctuation-dissipation theorem (FDT). In particular, near critical points, the divergence of the correlation length and the emergence of fractal geometry in spin clusters suggest the need for alternative frameworks. In this work, we explore the connection between critical exponents, fractal dimensions, and the thermodynamic formalism known as the Principium Luxuriae. By linking the thermodynamic fractal dimension D to the correlation length and entropy variations, we reinterpret energy dissipation in terms of multiscale processes. This approach allows us to reproduce effective scaling tendencies associated with the critical behavior of the 2d Ising model and provides new insight into how systems redistribute energy macroscopically during phase transitions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the decrease in D near the critical temperature marks a transition toward macroscopic coherence, where the system begins to dissipate energy across its entire scale. This unified behavior, however, induces a heightened sensitivity to perturbations, where local fluctuations are transmitted globally through the fractal network. This mechanism establishes a direct bridge between geometric structure, thermodynamic entropy, and the onset of dynamical instability (chaos) as the system approaches criticality.

papers.title: Disorder-Induced Logarithmic Spreading and Localization of Quantum Fluctuations
papers.abstract: Disorder can localize quantum particles, even in the presence of interactions, but its influence on quantum fluctuations beyond mean--field dynamics remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the propagation of quantum fluctuations in weakly interacting disordered bosonic systems by comparing the Bose--Hubbard model with the Gross--Pitaevskii equation. We find that, in contrast to ballistic spreading in the disorder--free system, quantum fluctuations exhibit logarithmic spreading at intermediate times under both random and quasiperiodic disorder, before eventually saturating. The spreading rate decreases algebraically with increasing disorder strength, and this behavior persists across different particle numbers and extends to two dimensions. Using a time--dependent Bogoliubov--de Gennes framework, we identify the localized mean--field wavefunction as a time--dependent pairing background that generates quantum fluctuations. The exponential suppression of fluctuation--generation rates with distance provides a physical mechanism for the logarithmically advancing fluctuation front. Our results reveal a distinct regime of disorder--controlled quantum--fluctuation dynamics and establish disorder as a means of controlling their spreading.

papers.title: Thermodynamic signatures of a nearby quantum critical endpoint in UTe$_2$ under intense magnetic field
papers.abstract: Several unconventional superconducting phases have been discovered in the vicinity of metamagnetism in the heavy-fermion paramagnet UTe$_2$ under magnetic field. To describe the mechanism of magnetic-field-induced superconductivity, a challenge is to characterize the quantum critical magnetic properties at the metamagnetic transition. In this work, we investigate the thermodynamic properties of UTe$_2$ under magnetic fields up to 60~T applied in the crystallographic $\mathbf{b}-\mathbf{c}$ plane. Magnetization and magnetostriction experiments have been performed under magnetic fields tilted by an angle $θ\lesssim42^\circ$ from $\mathbf{b}$ toward $\mathbf{c}$. They support that a quantum critical endpoint at the field angle $θ_{QCEP}\simeq(70\pm10)^\circ$ and magnetic field $μ_0H_{QCEP}\simeq(75\pm10)$~T terminates the metamagnetic transition line. A pseudo-gap in the magnetic susceptibility is related with the metamagnetic transition observed in magnetic fields for $θ<θ_{QCEP}$. The possible relation between the quantum critical endpoint and the development of magnetic-field-induced superconductivity is discussed.

研究问题：如何表征 UTe$_2$ 在变磁转变附近的量子临界磁性质，以理解磁场诱导超导机制？
证据与比较：在最高60 T、相对 b 向 c 倾斜 θ≲42° 的磁场下测量磁化与磁致伸缩；数据支持 θ_QCEP≃(70±10)°、μ0H_QCEP≃(75±10) T 的端点，并显示 θ<θ_QCEP 时磁化率中的赝能隙与变磁转变相关。
papers.method_zh: 在 b-c 面倾斜磁场中开展磁化与磁致伸缩实验，磁场最高60 T。

english_guide.finding: Magnetization and magnetostriction support a quantum critical endpoint at θ_QCEP≃(70±10)° and μ0H_QCEP≃(75±10) T terminating the metamagnetic transition line in UTe2.
english_guide.question: How can the quantum critical magnetic properties at the metamagnetic transition of UTe2 be characterized to describe magnetic-field-induced superconductivity?
english_guide.evidence: Measurements up to 60 T with fields tilted by θ≲42° from b toward c support the endpoint; a pseudo-gap in magnetic susceptibility is related to the metamagnetic transition for θ<θ_QCEP.
english_guide.method: Magnetization and magnetostriction experiments under magnetic fields up to 60 T applied in the b-c plane.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that the results support a quantum critical endpoint terminating the metamagnetic transition line and discuss its possible relation to magnetic-field-induced superconductivity.
english_guide.limitations: Measurements are limited to θ≲42°, so the endpoint is extrapolated; sample conditions and quantitative error details are not stated, and a causal link to superconductivity is not established.

papers.title: Universal Multichannel Coherence-Mediated Thermal Transport in Carbon Allotropes: Experimental Evidence and Scaling Laws
papers.abstract: Understanding thermal transport in structurally disordered carbon materials remains a fundamental challenge because conventional models based on a single coherence contribution cannot accurately describe heat conduction over a broad temperature range. In this work, the thermal conductivity of graphene oxide (GO), thermally reduced graphene oxide (trGO), GO-hydrated fullerene composites (GO-HyFn), expanded graphite (EG), and EG-multiwalled carbon nanotube (MWCNT) composites was measured between 4.5 and 300 K. Despite substantial differences in density, porosity, graphitic ordering, and microstructure, all materials exhibit glass-like temperature dependence of thermal conductivity. The experimental results demonstrate that the conventional two-channel model, comprising a Peierls contribution and a single thermally activated coherence term, systematically fails to reproduce the observed temperature dependence. To resolve this discrepancy, we propose a generalized multichannel phenomenological model in which the coherence contribution consists of up to three Arrhenius-type channels with distinct activation energies. Depending on the structural state, two or three coherence channels are required to accurately describe the thermal conductivity. A key finding is the reproducible hierarchy of activation energies across diverse carbon allotropes, following approximately (E2 ~ 4E1 and E3 ~ (12-25)E1). While the channel amplitudes increase with material density, the activation energies remain nearly invariant, indicating universal vibrational energy scales. The proposed framework also consistently describes published data for other disordered carbon materials. These results provide experimental evidence for multichannel coherence-mediated heat transport and establish a unified phenomenological bridge between structural hierarchy with thermal transport in disordered carbon solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验为主，辅以唯象模型拟合；依据为4.5–300 K热导率测量；研究对象：氧化石墨烯(GO)、热还原GO(trGO)、GO-水合富勒烯复合物(GO-HyFn)、膨胀石墨(EG)及EG-多壁碳纳米管(MWCNT)复合物
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多种结构差异显著的碳同素异形体均呈玻璃型热导率温度依赖，需用最多三个Arrhenius型相干通道才能描述，且激活能层级近似普适。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：传统双通道模型（Peierls项加单一热激活相干项）无法描述宽温区热导率，如何构建能统一描述无序碳材料热输运的模型？
证据与比较：在4.5–300 K测量五类样品热导率；尽管密度、孔隙率、石墨有序度和微结构差异大，均呈玻璃型温度依赖；双通道模型系统性无法复现；拟合需两或三个相干通道；激活能呈E2~4E1、E3~(12–25)E1的层级，通道幅度随密度增大而激活能近乎不变。

english_guide.finding: All measured carbon allotropes show glass-like thermal conductivity; a two-channel model fails, while two or three Arrhenius-type coherence channels describe the data, with a reproducible activation-energy hierarchy E2~4E1 and E3~(12-25)E1.
english_guide.question: How can heat conduction in disordered carbon over a broad temperature range be described when the conventional two-channel model fails?
english_guide.evidence: Thermal conductivity of GO, trGO, GO-HyFn, EG and EG-MWCNT composites was measured from 4.5 to 300 K; despite differences in density, porosity, graphitic ordering and microstructure, all show glass-like temperature dependence; channel amplitudes increase with density while activation energies remain nearly invariant.

english_guide.novelty: The authors claim experimental evidence for multichannel coherence-mediated heat transport and a unified phenomenological bridge between structural hierarchy and thermal transport in disordered carbon solids.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify sample preparation details or measurement uncertainty; universality rests on phenomenological fits to the present samples and published data.

papers.title: End-state-assisted tunneling at a topological insulator STM tip
papers.abstract: Recent spin-sensitive scanning tunneling experiments with topological-insulator tips motivate a microscopic understanding of how tip geometry controls current delivery. We show that topological end states mediate resonant tunneling through the gap opened by interedge hybridization in a quantum spin Hall tip. An asymmetric termination gives oppositely spin-polarized helical paths unequal effective lengths and resonance widths. Within an independent-path description, their transmitted-current imbalance vanishes at a matched resonance and becomes finite away from it. Coupling these directional channels to a $d$-wave altermagnet yields a spin-dependent interference contrast. Hybridized end states along a stepped termination provide multiple tunneling resonances. Our results establish end-state-mediated tunneling as a transport mechanism for STM with strongly confined topological tips.

研究问题：针尖几何如何通过末端态与边缘杂化控制拓扑绝缘体STM针尖的电流输运与自旋极化？
证据与比较：摘要给出独立路径描述下的透射电流不平衡：在匹配共振处为零、偏离时有限；与d波交变磁体耦合产生自旋相关干涉对比；阶梯终止的杂化末端态给出多个隧穿共振。

papers.title: Cohesive granular piles with controlled volume fraction
papers.abstract: Experimental procedures involving wet granular media expose the sample to variation of its organization across different measurements, leading to non reproducible results. Rigorous control over the preparation process and a thorough understanding of the microstructure of the granular heap are key parameters to manage results dispersion from one experiment to an other. In this study, we present a protocol to prepare large samples of wet grains in a cylindrical container. Quantitative results are presented showing the effectiveness of the protocol regarding : the accessibility of different granular materials with different volume fraction $φ_0$ and the reproducibility of this said density obtained experimentally in the same experimental conditions. In addition, X-ray scans were performed using a micro-CT scanner to dive into the microstructure of the carefully prepared piles. Results show a small variation between the bulk density $φ_0$ and the local one $φ$, underlining the homogeneity in the samples. On top of that, several scans made in the same medium at different heights confirm the homogeneity across a given sample.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；依据为制备方案、定量重复性测试与micro-CT扫描；研究对象：圆柱容器内湿颗粒堆（wet granular piles），体积分数φ0可控
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所提制备方案可在同一实验条件下获得不同体积分数φ0且可重复的湿颗粒大样品，micro-CT显示整体密度φ0与局部密度φ差异小、样品均匀。

研究问题：如何严格控制湿颗粒介质的制备过程，以减少不同测量间组织变化导致的不可重复结果，并获得大尺寸均匀样品？
证据与比较：摘要给出定量结果：方案可获取不同φ0的多种颗粒材料，同一实验条件下密度可重复；micro-CT扫描显示φ0与局部φ差异小，同一介质不同高度的多次扫描确认样品沿高度均匀。

papers.title: Mechanical pairing and self-assembled chains of non-convex granular rotors
papers.abstract: We experimentally and numerically demonstrate the self-assembly of granular rotors into chain-like structures. The rotors are non-convex rigid bodies with rotational activity. We first investigate the interaction between two rotors and we establish an attractive interaction controlled by the ratio of the rotational activity to the noise and also dependent of the rotors geometry. We then show that the cohesive state between spinner pairs leads to robust chains that can be either initially set or spontaneously obtained by self-assembly.

研究问题：非凸颗粒转子之间如何相互作用，以及这种相互作用能否驱动转子自组装成链状结构。
证据与比较：摘要报告：先考察两个转子间的相互作用，确立吸引相互作用受旋转活性与噪声之比控制并依赖转子几何；随后显示转子对间的凝聚态导致稳健链条，可初始设定或自发自组装获得。
papers.method_zh: 实验与数值模拟相结合，研究双转子相互作用及多转子链的自组装行为。

papers.title: Spin-glass order in a field requires magnetic-field chaos in XY gauge glasses for $d\leq 4$
papers.abstract: The XY gauge-glass model is believed to exhibit a spin-glass phase in dimensions $d\geq 3$. In this paper, we prove that, in dimensions $d\leq 4$ and at any finite temperature, a magnetic field applied in a fixed direction, with amplitudes that fluctuate from site to site according to the Rayleigh distribution, must either induce magnetic-field chaos in the spin-glass phase or destroy spin-glass order altogether, whenever a spin-glass phase exists at zero field. In particular, if a spin-glass phase persists under such a field, as predicted by the replica-symmetry-breaking (RSB) picture, it must exhibit magnetic-field chaos. This conclusion follows from our proof that, for any fixed nonzero field strength, the disorder average of the squared overlap between equilibrium spin configurations at zero field and those at nonzero field vanishes in the thermodynamic limit. By gauge transformations, the overlap statistics are identical to the magnetization statistics of an XY gauge glass with correlated bond disorder in a Gaussian random field. Our proof combines this exact identity with quantitative estimates on the suppression of ferromagnetic order by random fields in continuous-spin systems, due to Dario, Harel, and Peled [Commun. Math. Phys. 405, 212 (2024)] and building on the work of Imry and Ma [Phys. Rev. Lett. 35, 1399 (1975)] and of Aizenman and Wehr [Phys. Rev. Lett. 62, 2503 (1989); Commun. Math. Phys. 130, 489 (1990)]. We extend these estimates to bond-dependent interactions. Although our result provides a rare rigorous constraint on the nature of spin-glass phases in finite-dimensional systems, it does not determine whether spin-glass order survives in a field, and therefore does not distinguish between the droplet and RSB pictures. The case of a strictly uniform field remains open.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于严格数学证明，非实验或数值计算；研究对象：XY规范玻璃（XY gauge glass）模型，d≤4维、有限温度、固定方向随机场
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在d≤4维、任意有限温度下，若零场存在自旋玻璃相，则按Rayleigh分布逐点涨落的固定方向磁场要么在自旋玻璃相中诱导磁场混沌（magnetic-field chaos），要么完全破坏自旋玻璃序。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在d≤4维XY规范玻璃中，固定方向但逐点涨落的磁场与零场自旋玻璃序之间关系如何，自旋玻璃相能否在磁场中存续并呈现何种性质。
证据与比较：证明对任意固定非零场强，零场与非零场平衡自旋构型平方重叠（squared overlap）的无序平均在热力学极限下趋于零；经规范变换，该重叠统计等同于高斯随机场中关联键无序XY规范玻璃的磁化统计。
papers.method_zh: 结合重叠统计与磁化统计的精确恒等式，以及Dario、Harel、Peled对连续自旋系统中随机场抑制铁磁序的定量估计，并推广至键依赖相互作用。

english_guide.finding: For d≤4 at any finite temperature, a fixed-direction field with site-to-site Rayleigh-distributed amplitudes must either induce magnetic-field chaos in the spin-glass phase or destroy spin-glass order, whenever a zero-field spin-glass phase exists.
english_guide.question: How does a fixed-direction, site-random field relate to zero-field spin-glass order in the d≤4 XY gauge glass, and what must happen to the spin-glass phase under such a field?

english_guide.method: An exact identity between overlap and magnetization statistics combined with quantitative estimates of random-field suppression of ferromagnetic order in continuous-spin systems by Dario, Harel, and Peled, extended to bond-dependent interactions.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state a rare rigorous constraint on spin-glass phases in finite dimensions; if a spin-glass phase persists under the field as in the RSB picture, it must exhibit magnetic-field chaos.
english_guide.limitations: The result does not determine whether spin-glass order survives in a field and thus does not distinguish droplet from RSB pictures; the strictly uniform field case remains open.

papers.title: Memory of Initial States in Long-Time Dynamics Revealed by Non-Gaussianity
papers.abstract: In quantum dynamics of few-body observables in quadratic systems, information about the initial state is retained in long-time averages, as captured by the generalized Gibbs ensemble. Here, we show that this memory extends beyond the averages to temporal fluctuations around them. By generating a manifold of non-Gaussian initial states and quantifying their non-Gaussianity via the corresponding entropy, we find that the magnitude of temporal fluctuations is a smooth function of the initial-state non-Gaussianity. This relation explains the qualitatively different scaling of fluctuations observed after quantum quenches: exponentially small fluctuations for non-Gaussian initial states and polynomially small fluctuations for Gaussian initial states. Therefore, our results identify non-Gaussianity as a key to uncovering initial-state memory beyond long-time averages.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于二次型系统量子动力学的解析与态流形分析；研究对象：少体可观测量的二次型（quadratic）量子系统长时间动力学
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长时间涨落幅度是初态非高斯性（non-Gaussianity）的光滑函数，从而把初态记忆从长时间平均值扩展到其时间涨落。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：初态信息在长时间平均值之外是否也留存于时间涨落中，以及涨落幅度由初态的何种性质决定。
证据与比较：构造非高斯初态流形，用相应熵量化非高斯性，发现涨落幅度随非高斯性光滑变化；并据此解释淬火（quantum quench）后涨落的定性差异：非高斯初态呈指数小涨落，高斯初态呈多项式小涨落。
papers.method_zh: 在二次型系统中生成非高斯初态流形，以熵量化非高斯性，并分析长时间涨落与初态非高斯性的关系。

english_guide.finding: The magnitude of long-time temporal fluctuations is a smooth function of the initial-state non-Gaussianity, extending initial-state memory beyond long-time averages.
english_guide.question: Whether initial-state information persists in temporal fluctuations around long-time averages, and what property of the initial state controls fluctuation magnitude.
english_guide.evidence: A manifold of non-Gaussian initial states was generated and non-Gaussianity quantified via the corresponding entropy; fluctuation magnitude varies smoothly with non-Gaussianity, explaining exponentially small fluctuations for non-Gaussian initial states and polynomially small fluctuations for Gaussian initial states after quantum quenches.
english_guide.method: Analysis of long-time dynamics in quadratic systems using a manifold of non-Gaussian initial states and an entropy-based measure of non-Gaussianity.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that initial-state memory is extended beyond long-time averages to temporal fluctuations, identifying non-Gaussianity as key to uncovering memory beyond averages.
english_guide.limitations: Results are restricted to quadratic systems and few-body observables in long-time dynamics; the abstract does not specify the model, parameter ranges, or finite-size and numerical-precision conditions.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称将初态记忆从长时间平均值推广到时间涨落，并识别非高斯性为揭示平均值之外初态记忆的关键。
papers.limitations_zh: 结论限于二次型系统与少体可观测量的长时间动力学；摘要未明确说明具体模型、参数范围及有限尺寸或数值精度等条件。

papers.title: Particle-hole asymmetry and a fluctuating pair-density-wave state in a lightly doped Mott insulator on the square lattice
papers.abstract: Whether a lightly doped Mott insulator on the square lattice supports robust $d$-wave superconductivity remains a central question in strongly correlated physics and in the microscopic theory of cuprate superconductivity. Experiments and numerical studies reveal a pronounced particle-hole asymmetry, pointing to a delicate competition among $d$-wave superconductivity, pair-density wave (PDW), stripe, charge-density wave (CDW), and antiferromagnetic correlations. Here we combine large-scale DMRG and finite-size PEPS to study the square-lattice $t$-$J$ model at low doping, $δ\leq 0.1$, while tuning the next-nearest-neighbor hopping $t'$ from the electron-like ($t'>0$) to the hole-like ($t'<0$) regime. The electron-like side supports robust, nearly uniform $d$-wave pairing, whereas decreasing $t'$ induces a period-two plaquette modulation and ultimately produces, on the hole-like side, a charge-dominated state with a strongly suppressed static pairing amplitude. DMRG calculations on open strips and squares, together with PEPS calculations on open squares up to $16\times16$ sites, support this evolution. On squares with $C_4$-symmetric Hamiltonians, both methods find that the pair correlations of the hole-like state select the plaquette momenta $(π,0)$ and $(0,π)$ and decay within a few lattice spacings, while the dominant charge-density modulation forms a bidirectional checkerboard whose period extrapolates to about $4a_0$, close to that observed in lightly doped Bi-2201. These observations establish a fluctuating plaquette PDW in the lightly doped hole-like regime, in which local pairs carry finite momentum but lack phase coherence. Our results firmly establish particle-hole asymmetry as a central organizing principle for competing pairing tendencies in the lightly doped $t$-$J$ model.

papers.title: And yet it moves - or does it? Spurious drifts at equilibrium
papers.abstract: When diffusion depends on the state of a system, the drift measured from its trajectories contains a spurious part unrelated to forces. At equilibrium, particles can then appear to sediment, repel each other, even rotate - the same way whether the movie is played forward or backward. Drifts are conditional averages, not currents: they carry meaning only together with a consistently inferred diffusion tensor. Paired with the wrong one, they make passive particles look active. I show how to infer spurious drifts from trajectory moments alone, enabling thermodynamically consistent inference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于轨迹统计与热力学一致性分析；研究对象：平衡态下扩散依赖于体系状态的粒子轨迹
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当扩散依赖体系状态时，由轨迹测得的漂移含有与力无关的虚假部分，平衡态粒子可表现为沉降、互斥甚至旋转，且正放与倒放影像相同。

研究问题：如何从轨迹中识别并推断与力无关的虚假漂移，从而在扩散张量一致推断下实现热力学自洽的漂移测量？
证据与比较：摘要为概念与推导性论证：指出漂移是条件平均而非流，须与一致推断的扩散张量配对；错配会使被动粒子看似主动；并称可仅由轨迹矩推断虚假漂移。未给出具体数值或实验数据。

papers.title: Local electronic structure of the Co2+ ions in the disordered perovskite phase of Ba3CoNb2O9: a temperature-dependent X-ray absorption and magnetic circular dichroism study
papers.abstract: We performed temperature-dependent X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) measurements on the disordered phase of Ba$_3$CoNb$_2$O$_9$ to determine the local electronic structure of the Co$^{2+}$ ions. We employed the line-fitting inverse partial fluorescence yield (iPFY) method to obtain reliable spectra from this insulating material. From the comparison between the experimental spectra and full multiplet cluster calculations we were able to constrain the local crystal-field environment and assess the spin-orbit-entangled nature of the Co$^{2+}$ ground state. In this chemically disordered system, the Co$^{2+}$ ions retain on average an effectively cubic crystal-field environment that supports a $J_\mathrm{eff} = 1/2$ ground state. These results further establish that Ba$_3$CoNb$_2$O$_9$ is a promising platform for investigating the effect of disorder on $J_\mathrm{eff} = 1/2$ magnetism.

研究问题：确定化学无序钙钛矿相 Ba3CoNb2O9 中 Co2+ 的局域电子结构、晶场环境及基态性质。
证据与比较：温度依赖 XAS 与 XMCD 谱，经 iPFY 线拟合获得可靠绝缘体谱；与完全多重态团簇计算比较，约束晶场环境并评估自旋-轨道纠缠基态。

papers.title: Evidence of anomalous Hall crystals in moiré rhombohedral graphene
papers.abstract: An anomalous Hall crystal (AHC) is a quantum state of matter, in which spontaneous electron crystallization leads to a quantized Hall effect without a magnetic field. The state can emerge in materials with strong Coulomb interaction and large Berry curvatures, such as few-layer rhombohedral graphene. Although the idea of AHCs has been invoked to explain some of the observed Chern insulators in moiré rhombohedral graphene (mRG), direct experimental evidence of AHCs has been missing so far. Here, we report experimental evidence of AHCs in hole-doped mRG through combined electrical transport and noise measurements. We identify a series of distinct Chern insulators spanning a broad and continuous range of doping densities incommensurate with the underlying moiré lattice; the states exhibit current-induced broadband noise and memory effects as well as pronounced gate hysteresis. Systematic magnetic field, temperature and gate dependence studies further support the emergence of a spontaneously charge-ordered state that acts as a parental state for the observed Chern insulators. The absence of Chern insulators at nearby integer fillings also distinguishes the observed state from the reported reentrant or extended quantum (anomalous) Hall states. Altogether, our results establish experimental evidence of AHCs in mRG and open the door for further exploration of the collective dynamics in this new state of matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；依据为输运与噪声测量；研究对象：空穴掺杂的莫尔菱面石墨烯（moiré rhombohedral graphene, mRG）

papers.title: Thermodynamics of words
papers.abstract: We introduce the word thermalization hypothesis according to which in a literary work there are effective interactions between words that drive them to thermalization where their word frequency distribution is the same as for the phenomenon of Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation. In this concept, the different words play a role of classical oscillators (particles) and their word frequencies, or related tokens, are analogous to certain filling factors over energy state levels. The thermalization process is characterized by the conservation of total system energy, or total number of words/tokens, and total probability norm, or total number of different words. We apply this approach to analyze 16 literary works, including Bible, complete works of Shakespeare, and data from American National Corpus. We show that for these cases the effective system energy is very low and thus there is the RJ condensation phenomenon with a big fraction of total probability concentrated at the lowest energy states corresponding to a big fraction of rare words appearing only once or twice in the whole text. Such a RJ condensation is observed for light propagation in multimode optical fibers and other physical systems. We relate the thermalization of words to the recently proposed wealth thermalization for households in world countries. The economy concepts of Lorenz and Pareto curves, and also Zipf curves, are applied to the word frequency distributions of the selected 16 cases and it is shown that the thermalization theory gives a strikingly good description of real data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论建模与数据分析；基于词热化假设对文本统计拟合；研究对象：16部文学作品，包括《圣经》、莎士比亚全集及美国国家语料库数据

papers.title: Analytic Two-Radius Model for the Zero-Shear and High-Frequency Viscosity of Colloidal Suspensions
papers.abstract: Nearly hard-sphere colloids are stabilized by short-range repulsions that set their effective size and equilibrium microstructure. Their hydrodynamic interactions, in contrast, are set by the no-slip surface. Since these two do not necessarily coincide, there are potentially two effective radii that control their dynamics in different ways. Yet it is commonplace to model and analyze such suspensions with a single effective radius, which merges these different physics. Two-radius models, in which a hard, solvent-permeable shell surrounds a no-slip core, have been proposed to improve the description of these suspensions. Their rheology is known exactly at pair level, but at higher concentrations their zero-shear viscosity has been obtained only with semi-empirical expressions, which do not recover the exact pair result. Here, we close this gap with a theory for the zero-shear and high-frequency viscosity of these two-radius models. By keeping pairs out of near contact, the shell lowers the high-frequency viscosity, as our Stokesian dynamics simulations confirm, and shifts the zero-shear viscosity from hydrodynamic toward thermodynamic stress. We apply our theory to experiments on charge- and sterically stabilized colloids from the literature and find that it accurately describes the measured viscosities. We discuss the benefits of fitting data to a two-radius model compared to a single-radius one. To facilitate this fitting in future work, closed-form expressions are provided that cover the full range of shell thicknesses and volume fractions.

papers.title: Frequency Comb as a Probe of Fluctuation Mechanisms in Nanomechanical Systems
papers.abstract: Frequency combs are indispensable in metrology. We show that a frequency comb also probes frequency fluctuations of the system. In our nanomechanical resonator, the comb arises from self-sustained vibrations of a resonantly driven nonlinear mode. The comb lineshapes reveal exponentially correlated (Ornstein--Uhlenbeck) frequency noise. Its correlation time agrees with the independently measured relaxation time of the vibrations. The noise leads to anomalous phase diffusion. Its mechanism is generic: like the comb itself, it stems from the strong nonlinearity of the self-sustained vibrations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；基于纳米机械谐振器的测量与噪声分析；研究对象：共振驱动的非线性自持振动纳米机械谐振器（nanomechanical resonator）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 频率梳梳线线形揭示指数关联的Ornstein–Uhlenbeck频率噪声，其关联时间与独立测得的振动弛豫时间一致，并导致反常相位扩散。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：频率梳能否用于探测纳米机械系统的频率涨落，以及该涨落的统计性质与来源机制为何。
证据与比较：摘要给出梳线线形所反映的指数关联频率噪声，其关联时间与独立测量的振动弛豫时间相符，并报告该噪声导致反常相位扩散；未给出具体数值。
papers.method_zh: 利用共振驱动的非线性模式自持振动产生频率梳，分析梳线线形以提取频率噪声统计，并与独立弛豫时间测量比较。

english_guide.finding: Comb lineshapes reveal exponentially correlated (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck) frequency noise whose correlation time agrees with the independently measured relaxation time of the vibrations, leading to anomalous phase diffusion.
english_guide.question: Can a frequency comb probe frequency fluctuations of a nanomechanical system, and what are the statistics and origin of such noise?
english_guide.evidence: The comb lineshapes reveal exponentially correlated frequency noise; its correlation time agrees with the independently measured relaxation time, and the noise leads to anomalous phase diffusion. No numerical values are given.

papers.title: Rheology of Parametric Odd Materials
papers.abstract: The design and control of rheological properties in active systems are crucial for developing functional materials with novel properties. While significant attention has been devoted to odd viscosity and odd elasticity, comprehensive odd rheological models remain scarce. Here, we introduce and characterise a platform-agnostic odd viscoelastic material, where complex responses arise from parametric control of internal rotational degrees of freedom and are triggered by coupling between normal and shear stresses. Such control can be achieved through either parametric driving or a parametric nonlinear feedback. We further show that this coupling can induce rotation-driven fluidisation, transitioning the material from an elasticity-dominated to a viscosity-dominated regime. Lastly, we show that the interplay between odd and even sectors enhances the nonlinear material response under large-amplitude oscillatory shear (LAOS). The findings outline a route to Floquet-engineered metafluids with programmable, non-reciprocal rheology.

papers.title: Design of Self-Folding Origami Architectures for Biomedical Implants: A Finite Element Simulation Framework
papers.abstract: Minimally invasive brain implants require compact deployment geometries and controlled shape transformation for delivery through confined vessels. Origami-inspired structures enable large shape changes from compact to tailored deployed configurations, but implementation at microscale dimensions remains challenging, as conventional designs rely on predefined mountain and valley folds that become increasingly difficult to fabricate and assemble as unit-cell size is reduced to meet clinical requirements. To address this, we propose a self-folding methodology based on thermally induced stresses in thin-film bimetallic composites. Pairing the shape memory alloy Nitinol (NiTi) with molybdenum or stainless steel (SS316L) exploits their differing thermal expansion coefficients to generate localized hinge bending, enabling deterministic, autonomous folding into prescribed mountain and valley configurations. Using finite element simulations, we systematically optimize hinge length, layer thickness, width, and shape, identifying a hinge geometry achieving a ~50% reduction in unit-cell dimensions relative to previously reported designs. Integration into a complete waterbomb origami unit cell confirms that the strip-level folding mechanism scales to produce coordinated, self-folding deformation across the tessellated structure. These results demonstrate the feasibility of stress-induced, self-folding thin-film origami architectures built from clinically established biomaterials, providing a scalable design framework for next-generation, active neurovascular implants with integrated sensing and monitoring functionality.

papers.title: Chiral magnon Kerr interaction from linear and nonlinear Meissner screening in ferromagnet--superconductor bilayers
papers.abstract: Magnon Kerr interaction showing a dependence of magnon dispersion frequency on its population is a useful functionality for nonlinear and quantum magnonics; its strength and sign depend on magnetic anisotropy, bias, and mode geometry. We here propose to use a superconducting gate to tune the Kerr interaction of magnons in ferromagnetic insulators. Even when the superconductor responds linearly, the frequency shift induced by its reflected dipolar field depends on the longitudinal magnetization. The decrease of this magnetization with increasing precession amplitude therefore produces a Kerr contribution. We go beyond this linear Meissner-screening regime by showing that at finite excitation amplitude, the significant Meissner screening currents reduce the superfluid stiffness, thus enhancing the effective magnetic-field penetration and rendering the Meissner backaction amplitude dependent. This superflow-induced pair breaking adds a second Kerr contribution, controlled by the interfacial superflow relative to the nonlinear screening scale. For yttrium iron garnet gated by dirty niobium, we predict a significant renormalization of the Kerr effect by superconductors, with the resulting Kerr contribution strongly chiral in the Damon--Eshbach configuration. By showing that the linear and nonlinear Meissner screening to the Kerr interaction can be distinguished by varying temperature, our work establishes a route to directional control of magnon nonlinear interactions.

papers.title: A phase-field model of viscous surfaces in fluids
papers.abstract: Viscous surfaces play a crucial role in biological and industrial multiphase flows, yet their simulation remains challenging due to complex rheology and topological changes. We present a thermodynamically consistent phase-field model for viscous surfaces in incompressible Navier-Stokes fluids, incorporating surface shear and dilatational viscosities via the Boussinesq-Scriven constitutive law. The diffuse-interface formulation is derived from a sharp-interface model and rigorously validated through matched asymptotic analysis, confirming recovery of the correct sharp-interface limit. We develop an unconditionally energy-dissipative time discretization, ensuring numerical stability. The model is validated through a quantitative benchmark against analytical solutions for surface flows on a rigid sphere, and a simulation of vesicle fusion showing preservation of energy dissipation across topological transitions. These results demonstrate that the framework enables robust, physically consistent simulations of complex surface dynamics, including large deformations and topological changes, without explicit surface tracking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算；基于相场模型推导与数值模拟；研究对象：不可压缩Navier-Stokes流体中的粘性表面（viscous surfaces）

papers.title: Orchestr.AI: A Unified Workflow for Training and Benchmarking of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: Machine-learning force fields enable atomistic simulations at near-reference accuracy and substantially reduced computational cost, but their development remains fragmented across software frameworks with incompatible data formats, configuration schemes, dependencies, and execution procedures. Orchestr.AI addresses this limitation through a unified workflow that coordinates different MLIP software frameworks, referred to as engines, for data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment. A common YAML interface defines each experiment, while engine-specific environment profiles preserve compatible software stacks and avoid dependency conflicts. The platform currently supports five MLIP model architectures, namely SchNet, PaiNN, NequIP, Allegro, and MACE, through their corresponding software implementations, providing automated configuration mapping and standardized dataset handling across these frameworks. Benchmarks on the rMD17 and 3BPA datasets show that Orchestr.AI reproduces the expected performance trends while enabling controlled cross-engine comparisons. Repeated executions with fixed configurations and engine profiles produce highly consistent results, demonstrating practical workflow reproducibility. Beyond training, Orchestr.AI provides modular architectural interfaces that connect trained models to ASE-based simulations, batch inference, epistemic uncertainty estimation, calibration, and active-learning workflows. The platform therefore provides a reproducible and extensible infrastructure for developing, comparing, and deploying machine-learning interatomic potentials, which we validate here through cross-engine accuracy and repeatability benchmarks.
