papers.title: Purely elastic centre-mode instability in channel and pipe flows of a simplified Phan-Thien-Tanner fluid
papers.abstract: Recent work identified spatially localised midplane stress structures as the building blocks of chaotic behaviour in pressure-driven parallel shear flows of viscoelastic fluids. Such coherent structures are thought to originate from a linear centre-mode instability of the laminar state. In the absence of inertia, however, the Oldroyd-B and FENE-P constitutive models predict that this instability is confined to ultra-dilute polymer solutions and very large Weissenberg numbers in channel flow, while no purely elastic instability has been reported in pipe flow. Here, we study numerically the linear stability of channel and pipe flows of a simplified Phan-Thien-Tanner (sPTT) fluid and find a purely elastic centre-mode instability in both geometries across a wide range of polymer concentrations and at much lower Weissenberg numbers. Since the sPTT and FENE-P models have identical steady rheology and laminar profiles, their contrasting predictions indicate that the existence of the centre-mode instability is governed by the transient rheological response of the fluid. Our results suggest that the purely elastic centre-mode instability should be observable under realistic flow conditions. They also offer a means of discriminating between constitutive models.

papers.title: Landau Theory of Black-Brane Phase Transitions from Kasner Singularities
papers.abstract: We develop a Landau theory of a continuous black-brane phase transition using the geometry of the black-hole interior. The normal phase has a Reissner--Nordström Cauchy horizon, whereas the scalarized phase ends at a Kasner singularity. A conserved radial charge determines the grand potential from either endpoint and permits a direct phase comparison. At the critical point, we show analytically that the quadratic correction to the conserved radial charge vanishes. Using the inverse Kasner scalar velocity as an interior order parameter, we then construct a Landau potential whose coefficients are determined entirely from the terminal singularity. The Iyer--Wald first law relates this potential to the conventional boundary Landau theory and fixes its quartic coefficient. For two models with different scalar self-interactions, the resulting theory predicts the critical scaling of the Kasner order parameter and the grand-potential difference between the phases, in agreement with fully backreacted numerical solutions.

papers.title: Thermodynamic Formalism for Non-Invariant Probabilities: Entropy, Divergence, Channels
papers.abstract: Let $\mathcal{M}$ and $\mathcal{M}_σ$ denote, respectively, the sets of Borel and $σ$-invariant probabilities on the uncountable set $Ω=\{1,2,...,d\}^\mathbb{N}$. Given a Hölder Jacobian $J$, the dual Ruelle operator $μ\in \mathcal{M} \mapsto \mathcal{L}_{J}^* (μ)$ will play the role of a dynamical channel; generalizes the action of a stochastic matrix on probability vectors. Since $\mathcal{L}_{J}^*$ generally breaks $σ$-invariance, we introduce the \emph{ni-entropy} $h_{ni}(μ)$ for non-invariant measures, employing the concept of the expected value function on cylinders of size one. $h_{ni}(μ)$ differs from Shannon entropy but extends the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy from $\mathcal{M}_σ$ to $\mathcal{M}$; $h_{ni}$ is concave and u.s.c. This leads us to the concept of ni-pressure $\mathcal{P}(A)$ of a potential $A:Ω\to \mathbb{R}$. $μ\in \mathcal{M}$ is not a density with respect to a dominating measure. We define an {\it ni-Kullback-Leibler divergence} $D_{ni}(ρ|| ν)$ not assuming absolute continuity. We investigate concepts of Information Theory such as Minimal Output Entropy, Donsker-Varadhan variational principle, a variational formula for $h_{ni}$, bounds for divergence, information projections, and their connections to the ni-pressure $\mathcal{P}$.

papers.title: Inverse Scattering & Isospectrality in (Analog) Cosmology
papers.abstract: Cosmological particle production, the excitation of field quanta by a dynamical spacetime, underlies the primordial perturbations observed in the cosmic microwave background and has been realized in analog quantum simulators with ultra-cold atoms. We ask the inverse question: given the excitation spectrum, can the cosmological history that produced it be reconstructed, and is that reconstruction unique? We approach this problem through a mapping of particle production to one-dimensional quantum scattering, in which the expansion history plays the role of a scattering landscape and the produced spectrum the role of reflected and transmitted waves. This mapping reveals a rich interplay between scattering theory and cosmology. The scale factor enters as a zero-energy resonance, an exceptional case of scattering theory, while cosmic singularities correspond to bound states, so that regular cosmologies are governed entirely by the scattering continuum. We find an interesting isospectrality: histories related by an inversion of the scale factor (expansion <-> contraction) yield identical particle numbers, differing only by a pi-shift in phase. Given both the particle number (or alternatively the amplitude) and phase of the cosmological power spectrum, the reconstruction is unique for regular, asymptotically static cosmologies. We demonstrate the reconstruction both analytically, for exactly solvable scattering landscapes, and numerically, recovering common logistic expansion histories to better than 0.02%. We further quantify its robustness to the momentum-space resolution and measurement uncertainties characteristic of analog quantum simulation. This work establishes a direct link between the observable power spectrum and the cosmological history that produced it, offering a new perspective on the classification of early-universe scenarios and the construction of alternatives to inflation.

papers.title: Assessing the expressive power of a gauge-invariant PEPS ansatz across a topological phase transition
papers.abstract: We investigate the expressive power of the gauged Gaussian fermionic projected entangled pair state (GGFPEPS) ansatz, which is a manifestly gauge-invariant tensor network ansatz for $(2+1)$-dimensional lattice gauge theories. In the GGFPEPS ansatz, the gauge field on each link is represented by coupling its configuration to the fermion number of virtual fermions placed at both ends of the link. This ansatz has been studied by variational Monte Carlo (VMC) methods in previous work~\cite{Emonts:2022yom}. However, the statistical error of VMC makes a precise determination of the variational parameters difficult, so that the expressive power of the ansatz could not be examined accurately. In this work, we reformulate the computation as a Grassmann tensor network (TN), in which the whole network is contracted deterministically, and introduce the higher-order tensor renormalization group (HOTRG), which allows us to perform calculations in large volumes up to $L=34$. We also evaluate the infinite volume system using the corner transfer matrix renormalization group (CTMRG). We find that the ansatz with only eight complex variational parameters accurately describes the pure $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge theory including the region of the topological phase transition, not only in the energy but also in the topological entanglement entropy. The critical coupling obtained from the peaks of their susceptibilities agrees quantitatively with the one predicted by continuous-time quantum Monte Carlo simulations~\cite{wu2012phase}. Furthermore, near the transition point, we show that the ansatz represents a state outside the plaquette product family, which is a one-parameter family of states assumed in the construction of the ansatz as a simple interpolation between the strong and weak coupling limits.

papers.title: Hierarchical interfacial anchoring for durable perovskite solar cells
papers.abstract: Although inverted perovskite solar cells now deliver certified efficiencies approaching their single-junction limits, their practical deployment remains constrained by the thermo-mechanical fragility of buried interfaces under realistic temperature fluctuations. Here, we identify thermo-mechanically driven, stress-accumulation-dominated adhesion failure at self-assembled monolayer-based buried interfaces as a critical failure mode in inverted perovskite solar cells. To address this issue, we propose an interfacial robustness design strategy based on a homometallic halide pretreatment, which constructs a chemically compatible and highly anchorable interfacial environment on transparent conductive oxides to guide the ordered assembly of SAMs. This interfacial treatment increases the density of surface hydroxyl species and enables hierarchical multipoint interfacial anchoring dominated by metal-oxygen coordination, with Cl- induced hydrogen-bonding interactions acting cooperatively, thereby enhancing anchoring robustness and improving tolerance to thermo-mechanical stress accumulation. With this interfacial strategy, the devices achieve a power conversion efficiency of 27.3% (26.9% certified) and retain 94% of their initial efficiency after 400 temperature cycles between -40 and 85 degrees C (ISOS-T-3). These results demonstrate that rational regulation of buried interfacial anchoring architectures can simultaneously enhance device efficiency and long-term operational reliability, offering a viable pathway toward high-efficiency and durable perovskite photovoltaics.

papers.title: Chemotactic recruitment offsets congestion in honeybee trophallaxis
papers.abstract: Honeybee colonies distribute food by trophallaxis, a sequence of local interactions in which nectar donors transfer resources to hungry nestmates. Efficient transfer requires a searcher to find a donor and then be served. Chemical signals may draw searchers to a donor, though the crowd they form may block the way. We develop a stochastic framework coupling velocity-jump search that depends on chemical signaling to random-order service at donor aggregations, and measure trophallactic efficiency by the time the colony needs to feed a prescribed fraction of its members. Directed recruitment emerges because fed bees linger near donors and strengthen local chemical cues, but lingering also slows service. Trophallactic efficiency is therefore maximized at an intermediate abandonment rate that balances recruitment against congestion. We determine when displaced cues remain useful and how competing donors partition searchers. With two donors of unequal service rate, the faster one produces fed bees sooner and so advertises more strongly, drawing recruitment toward the donor that can sustain more throughput and away from the one that would congest. Together, these results show how feedback between service and signaling can self-organize recruitment to match local service capacity without centralized coordination.

papers.title: How wide must an eavesdropper be? Leakage of a toric-code logical bit to a strip and the Nishimori point
papers.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computers hand pieces of each logical qubit to separate decoder modules and shared readout lines. How much does a piece reveal? We prove that for any region and any Pauli noise, including correlated noise, an observer's optimal advantage in learning a logical bit is exactly 1 - 2 P_fail, where P_fail is the failure probability of maximum-likelihood decoding confined to that region. Two lessons follow. Geometry, not noise, provides the protection: a region that misses a single column of the code learns exactly nothing at any noise level, while a region that spans the code is protected by noise only at impractical distances (d > 350 for one row at a 10^-3 flip rate). And width is a poor guide to risk: under i.i.d. noise a two-row strip learns exactly as little as one row, yet below threshold an eavesdropper needs a width growing only as ln d. Through the identity, the strip's operational threshold is the Nishimori point of the random-bond Ising model, and a Walsh-Hadamard transfer matrix up to width 16 locates it to within a few thousandths. On two IBM Heron processors (d = 3, 5), an emulated strip adversary shows the predicted jump at width three, and non-uniform qubit errors let a trained attacker profit from the second row that uniform noise makes useless. We turn these results into design rules for partitioned decoding and multiplexed readout. Code and data are included.

papers.title: Chemotactic Horizons Regulate Threshold Dynamics in the Biological Carbon Pump
papers.abstract: Microbial encounters with sinking marine snow regulate organic carbon remineralization, acting as a critical knob in the ocean's biological carbon pump. Yet how the vast diversity of microbes in the open ocean respond to natural chemotactic cues coupling sedimentation-induced flow to microbial encounters in the ocean remains unresolved. Here we report shipboard measurements of microbial motility around freshly collected marine snow under imposed flows spanning ecologically relevant sinking speeds. Via high resolution single cell tracking at sea, we map a highly diverse repertoire of microbial motility, including rapid switching between motile and non-motile states. We identify a chemotactic horizon from measured reorientation towards chemical gradients, defining a spatial region around an aggregate within which chemotactic alignment overcomes flow-induced rotation due to sedimentation. This interplay produces a non-monotonic dependence of encounter rates on aggregate sinking speed, with a peak at 14.4 m/day followed by a sharp decline beyond 78.1 m/day, with a tracer-like regime at high effective sinking speeds. We incorporate the measured encounter rates into a kinetic transport equation in position-velocity phase space, with an effective nonlinear damping arising from velocity-dependent remineralization. The resulting particle dynamics reveal a threshold-induced separatrix dividing overdamped and ballistic microbial populations, leading to velocity segregation. Our study connects direct measurements of microbial motility and sedimentation-induced flow to the emergent phase-space for fate of marine snow in the biological pump, establishing a quantitative multiscale framework for investigating ocean carbon export.

papers.title: Everything in its right place: attention is a radio head
papers.abstract: Attention, the core of language models, is a digital calculation over tokens: an exponential selects them, a division normalizes and a positional code sets the order. We show that attention can instead emerge from the synchronization of a receiver with its context tokens. Each past token is an oscillator whose state carries its content and whose frequency drifts with its age. The present token selects them by content, aligning an antenna with its query, and by position, setting the frequency of a receiver with its dial. Solving Kuramoto's problem for this receiver yields an attention layer in closed form with two phases: above a critical coupling set by the context, the receiver locks and its weights normalize; below it, it stays silent and its weights sum to less than one. Trained networks use both phases to select, abstain and count, fail where the theory predicts and keep reading far beyond the training length. Each part of attention finds its place in one device, a radio head: it tunes in to what to hear and when, and stays silent when nothing relevant is on air.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于振荡器同步模型推导注意力层闭式解；研究对象：语言模型中的注意力机制（attention），以接收器与上下文token振荡器同步建模

papers.title: Finite Measured Entropy Production Does Not Imply Finite Microscopic Irreversibility
papers.abstract: Coarse-grained measurements provide a lower bound on entropy production, but how much microscopic irreversibility can they conceal? We construct a driven quantum system in which an imperfect counter registers a finite, strictly positive arrow of time while the microscopic entropy production is infinite. The system is a degenerate parametric oscillator below threshold, coupled to a thermal reservoir through repeated interactions with bosonic ancillas. The oscillator sustains a finite, positive heat current into the vacuum bath, where absorption is forbidden and forward and reverse trajectory laws have different supports. A photon counter with finite collection efficiency, gated time bins, and independent dark counts defines a common coarse-graining of the aligned trajectory laws. For fixed observation duration $\mathcal T$ and detector parameters, we prove that the observed relative entropy remains uniformly bounded as the bath temperature $T_b$ vanishes and is strictly positive at vacuum. The hidden contribution obeys $Σ_{\mathrm{hid}}(\mathcal T,T_b)=\mathcal T\dot Q_0/(k_BT_b)+O(1)$, where $\dot Q_0>0$ is the stationary vacuum heat current. False positives conceal the support mismatch while preserving measurable time asymmetry. Thus, finite and informative measurements of entropy production can coexist with infinite microscopic irreversibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于开放量子系统模型的严格证明；研究对象：阈值下简并参量振荡器，经玻色辅助系统与热库重复相互作用

papers.title: Surface codes with coherent errors: optimal decoding and finite-size crossovers
papers.abstract: We study the surface code under uniform coherent $Z$ rotations $\exp{(iθZ)}$ followed by perfect syndrome measurements, a setting known to exhibit strong finite-size effects that complicate the extraction of the asymptotic decoding threshold. We identify finite-size behavior of both Pauli decoding measures and the coherent information with two characteristic lengths: an algebraic ballistic-crossover scale $d_{\mathrm{ba}}\sim 1/β_R^α$ ($α=1$ for odd $d$ and $α=2$ for even $d$) and a much larger renormalization-group scale $d_\mathrm{RG}\sim \exp{(C/β^{4}_R)}$, where $β_R=-\tfrac{1}{2}\ln\tanθ$ and $d$ is the system size. As $θ$ approaches the ballistic SWAP point $π/4$, the two length scales diverge at very different rates, leaving a broad intermediate regime $d_{\mathrm{ba}}\ll d\ll d_\mathrm{RG}$ in which these quantities show substantial finite-size drift and approximate plateaus. To establish the microscopic basis of this crossover picture, we derive a leading inter-flavor quartic interaction of order $β_R^2$ in the replicated Majorana theory, which provides a route to the class-D nonlinear sigma model. The resulting marginal RG flow motivates the scaling variable $X_4=β_R^4\ln d$, in which free-fermion simulations show approximate collapse of decoding measures. These results are consistent with a Pauli-decoding threshold at $θ_c=π/4$ in the thermodynamic limit. For any even $d$, we prove that maximum-likelihood Pauli decoding maximizes entanglement fidelity over all deterministic syndrome-conditioned quantum recoveries, and that its decoding threshold attains the quantum-optimal limit, coinciding with the one defined by coherent information.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算，含解析推导与自由费米子数值模拟；研究对象：均匀相干Z旋转exp(iθZ)加完美syndrome测量下的surface code（表面码）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限尺寸行为由两个特征尺度控制：弹道交叉尺度d_ba与更大的重整化群尺度d_RG，二者在θ趋近π/4时以不同速率发散，形成宽中间区。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何理解相干误差下surface code的强有限尺寸效应，并从中提取渐近解码阈值？
证据与比较：推导出复制Majorana理论中量级为β_R^2的领头inter-flavor四次相互作用；得到边缘RG流及标度变量X_4=β_R^4 ln d，自由费米子模拟显示解码度量近似坍缩；并证明偶数d下最大似然Pauli解码最大化纠缠保真度。
papers.method_zh: 复制Majorana理论、class-D非线性sigma模型、边缘RG分析，以及自由费米子数值模拟。

english_guide.finding: Finite-size behavior is governed by a ballistic crossover scale d_ba ~ 1/β_R^α and a much larger RG scale d_RG ~ exp(C/β_R^4), producing a broad intermediate regime with drift and approximate plateaus.
english_guide.question: How to extract the asymptotic decoding threshold of the surface code under uniform coherent Z rotations despite strong finite-size effects?
english_guide.evidence: A leading inter-flavor quartic interaction of order β_R^2 in the replicated Majorana theory; marginal RG flow motivating X_4=β_R^4 ln d with approximate collapse of decoding measures in free-fermion simulations; proof that maximum-likelihood Pauli decoding maximizes entanglement fidelity for even d.
english_guide.method: Replicated Majorana theory, class-D nonlinear sigma model, marginal RG analysis, and free-fermion simulations.
english_guide.novelty: Authors claim identification of two characteristic lengths and an intermediate plateau regime, a microscopic basis for the crossover picture, and quantum-optimal maximum-likelihood Pauli decoding for even d.
english_guide.limitations: Restricted to uniform coherent Z rotations with perfect syndrome measurements; threshold consistency is in the thermodynamic limit; finite-d numerical ranges and errors are not specified in the abstract.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称识别出两个特征长度与中间平台区，给出交叉图像的微观基础，并证明偶数d下最大似然Pauli解码的量子最优性。

papers.title: Categorical RMT
papers.abstract: Random matrix theory (RMT) describes the level statistics of chaotic systems one symmetry sector at a time. We propose its analogue for local quantum systems on a circle with ordinary or non-invertible symmetries. Symmetry defects define twisted Hilbert spaces, and the symmetry sectors are irreducible representations of the tube algebra, which acts within and between these spaces. Under our proposal, the symmetry fixes exact degeneracies and identifications among sectors, and ordinary RMT describes the rest, with unrelated blocks treated as statistically independent. We call this categorical RMT. For a non-invertible symmetry it goes beyond ordinary RMT, since Hilbert spaces with different twists can share a sector, and so part of their spectrum, though no invertible symmetry relates them. We confirm this in a chaotic Fibonacci anyon chain, and check the framework in chaotic $S_3$ chains. We extend categorical RMT to primary states at fixed spin in 1+1-dimensional CFTs, where modular covariance requires additional correlations. For continuous symmetries, the Sugawara construction and spectral flow isolate a neutral spectrum, which can have symplectic statistics even in a bosonic theory. In holographic CFTs, torus wormholes decorated by the SymTFT or by Chern--Simons theory realize the predicted ramp and its modular completion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论为主，辅以数值验证（混沌任意子链与S_3链）；研究对象：圆周上的局部量子系统、混沌Fibonacci任意子链、混沌S_3链及1+1维CFT
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“范畴RMT”：对称性（含非可逆对称性）固定精确简并及扇区间的认同，其余谱由普通RMT描述，不同twist的Hilbert空间可共享扇区。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何将逐对称扇区适用的随机矩阵理论推广到具有普通或非可逆对称性的圆周局部量子系统，并刻画对称性对能级统计的约束。
证据与比较：在混沌Fibonacci任意子链中确认不同twist的Hilbert空间可共享扇区及部分谱；在混沌S_3链中检验框架；并讨论全息CFT中由SymTFT或Chern–Simons理论装饰的环面虫洞实现预测的ramp及其模完成。
papers.method_zh: 以管代数（tube algebra）的不可约表示定义对称扇区，对称缺陷给出twisted Hilbert空间；结合普通RMT、模协变性、Sugawara构造与谱流分析。

english_guide.question: How can random matrix theory, which describes level statistics one symmetry sector at a time, be generalized to local quantum systems on a circle with ordinary or non-invertible symmetries?

english_guide.method: Symmetry defects define twisted Hilbert spaces; sectors are irreducible representations of the tube algebra acting within and between these spaces; ordinary RMT, modular covariance, the Sugawara construction and spectral flow are used.
english_guide.novelty: For a non-invertible symmetry it goes beyond ordinary RMT, since Hilbert spaces with different twists can share a sector, and so part of their spectrum, though no invertible symmetry relates them.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not state applicability conditions or quantitative errors; checks are limited to specific chaotic chains, and the holographic realization is a theoretical construction.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称该框架对非可逆对称性超越普通RMT：不同twist的Hilbert空间可共享扇区与部分谱，且无任何可逆对称性联系它们。

papers.title: Kinematic Quantum Geometry
papers.abstract: Kinematic quantum geometry describes fast degrees of freedom (DOFs) that adiabatically follow states parametrized by both the coordinates and the velocities of slow DOFs. It extends Born-Oppenheimer geometry, which depends on coordinates alone, introduces mixed Berry curvatures, and modifies the effective theory governing the slow DOFs. We test its predictions in two setups: spinful particles moving in magnetic textures, and Dirac electrons in graphene coupled to an LC circuit. In the first, kinematic quantum geometry produces a velocity-dependent effective mass tensor and generates a Lorentz-like force nonlinear in velocity that can arise even in coplanar textures. In the second, it renormalizes the circuit capacitance and generates a Hall current nonlinear in the electric field. For small velocities, it reproduces recent results for electronic dynamics in external electromagnetic fields and in pseudospin textures. However, the framework can remain valid at large velocities beyond the perturbative regime, provided the kinematic states are sufficiently slowly varying.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；提出并检验运动学量子几何框架；研究对象：磁性织构中的自旋粒子；石墨烯狄拉克电子与LC电路耦合体系
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 运动学量子几何（kinematic quantum geometry）使慢自由度有效理论出现速度依赖的有效质量张量、速度非线性的类洛伦兹力，以及重整化电容和电场非线性霍尔电流。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何把仅依赖坐标的Born-Oppenheimer几何推广到同时依赖慢自由度坐标与速度的情形，并确定其对慢自由度有效理论的影响。
证据与比较：摘要给出两个检验情形：磁性织构中产生速度依赖有效质量张量与速度非线性类洛伦兹力，且共面织构中也可出现；石墨烯-LC电路中电容被重整化并产生电场非线性霍尔电流；小速度下复现外电磁场及赝自旋织构中的近期结果。
papers.method_zh: 构建运动学量子几何框架，引入混合Berry曲率（mixed Berry curvatures），推导慢自由度有效理论，并在两个具体体系中检验预言。

english_guide.question: How can Born-Oppenheimer geometry, which depends on coordinates alone, be extended to states parametrized by both coordinates and velocities of slow degrees of freedom, and how does this modify the effective theory?

papers.title: Holographic Drag Force and the Entanglement Membrane: Geometric Reconstruction and Information Spreading
papers.abstract: A central question in holography is how different boundary observables encode and reconstruct the geometry of the gravitational dual. In this work, we uncover an exact geometric correspondence between two seemingly distinct aspects of strongly coupled dynamics: the dissipative drag force experienced by a moving heavy particle(quark) and the entanglement membrane governing the propagation of quantum information. We show that both constructions retain the same underlying structure of the geometry, leading to an invertible transformation between the finite-velocity drag force and the geometric membrane tension. This correspondence reveals that nonlinear momentum loss encodes detailed information about entanglement dynamics: the leading nonlinear correction determines the butterfly velocity, while higher-order terms successively probe the local geometry of the membrane near the horizon. We further connect this hierarchy to scalar pole-skipping, establishing an all-order relation between nonlinear dissipation and near-horizon spectral data. The shared geometric structure also has implications for quantum information recovery, with the quintic drag coefficient determining the leading dependence of information velocity on initial entanglement. Conversely, the complete information-velocity curve provides a reconstruction of the reduced bulk geometry along the physical interior membrane branch, complementing the exterior reconstruction from drag. We show that stochastic momentum broadening supplies the additional radial information needed to reconstruct the complete exterior metric up to an overall scale. Our results thus reveal how dissipation, entanglement dynamics, and spectral properties provide complementary access to holographic geometry, establishing a unified framework for understanding the geometric information encoded in distinct boundary observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于全息对偶的解析推导；研究对象：强耦合规范场全息对偶中的拖曳力、纠缠膜与近视界几何
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拖曳力与纠缠膜张力之间存在可逆的几何对应，非线性耗散逐阶编码纠缠动力学与近视界谱信息。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何从边界可观测量重构引力对偶几何，以及拖曳力与纠缠膜这两种强耦合动力学描述之间是否存在精确几何联系。
证据与比较：摘要给出拖曳力与膜张力的可逆变换；指出领头非线性修正决定蝴蝶速度，更高阶项依次探测膜近视界局部几何，并建立与标量 pole-skipping 的全阶关系。
papers.method_zh: 在全息框架下解析比较有限速度拖曳力与纠缠膜的几何结构，并联系近视界谱数据与随机动量展宽。

english_guide.question: How do distinct boundary observables encode and reconstruct the gravitational dual geometry, and how are drag force and entanglement membrane geometrically related?
english_guide.evidence: The abstract reports an invertible transformation between drag force and membrane tension, the leading nonlinear correction fixing butterfly velocity, higher-order terms probing near-horizon membrane geometry, and an all-order relation to scalar pole-skipping.

english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify spacetime dimension, coupling regime, or conditions for the correspondence, and gives no quantitative validation details.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称发现拖曳力与纠缠膜张力的精确可逆几何对应，并建立非线性耗散与近视界谱数据的全阶关系。

papers.title: Time Direction Entanglement Entropy of Free Fermion Ground States
papers.abstract: While the entanglement entropy of a spatial subregion has been extensively studied, a properly defined entanglement entropy of quantum states in a time direction interval remains underexplored. We investigate the scaling behaviors of the recently defined time direction entanglement entropy (TDEE) for free fermion quantum states, which is computed from the reduced density matrix of a sub-Hilbert space that minimally supports all the time-evolved operators in the time direction interval. Based on the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture for Toeplitz matrices, we develop an analytical framework for understanding the TDEE in a time interval with discrete time step $τ$. For disorderless one-dimensional (1D) systems (gapless fermions or band insulators), in different regimes of gap, bandwidth and $τ$, we find the TDEE can exhibit area law (for nonzero gap), logarithmic law or volume law in the length of time. For 1D Anderson insulators, we numerically find the TDEE shows a Page-curve like behavior, growing at short time, and decaying in power-law at long time exceeding the crossover time determined by localization. In the continuum time limit $τ\rightarrow 0$, the TDEE of disorderless gapless fermions, band insulators and Anderson insulators exhibit logarithmic law, area law and sub-area law, respectively. We also show that the sub-Hilbert space of a time-direction interval stabilizes in the $τ\rightarrow 0$ limit, which is understandable as a subspace of the Hilbert space of the Lieb-Robinson causal diamond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算；基于Toeplitz矩阵解析框架与数值计算；研究对象：自由费米子基态，包括一维无能隙费米子、能带绝缘体与Anderson绝缘体
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间方向纠缠熵（TDEE）随时间的标度行为依赖能隙、带宽与离散时间步τ：无能隙与能带绝缘体呈面积律、对数律或体积律，Anderson绝缘体呈类Page曲线。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何定义并刻画量子态在时间方向区间上的纠缠熵，其随区间长度与离散时间步τ的标度行为是什么？
证据与比较：基于Toeplitz矩阵的Fisher–Hartwig猜想给出TDEE解析框架；对不同能隙、带宽与τ区间分类得到面积律、对数律、体积律；数值显示Anderson绝缘体短时增长、超过局域化决定的交叉时间后幂律衰减；τ→0极限下三类体系分别为对数律、面积律、亚面积律。
papers.method_zh: 以最小支撑时间区间内所有时间演化算符的子希尔伯特空间约化密度矩阵定义TDEE，用Toeplitz矩阵Fisher–Hartwig猜想解析计算，并辅以数值计算。

english_guide.finding: The time direction entanglement entropy (TDEE) of free fermion ground states shows area, logarithmic, or volume law scaling in time length depending on gap, bandwidth, and discrete time step τ; 1D Anderson insulators show a Page-curve-like behavior with short-time growth and long-time power-law decay.
english_guide.question: How to properly define and characterize the entanglement entropy of quantum states in a time direction interval, and what are its scaling behaviors with interval length and discrete time step τ?
english_guide.evidence: An analytical framework based on the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture for Toeplitz matrices yields area, logarithmic, and volume laws across regimes of gap, bandwidth, and τ; numerics show Anderson insulators grow at short time and decay in power-law beyond a localization-determined crossover; in the τ→0 limit, gapless fermions, band insulators, and Anderson insulators exhibit logarithmic, area, and sub-area laws, respectively.
english_guide.method: TDEE is computed from the reduced density matrix of a sub-Hilbert space minimally supporting all time-evolved operators in the time interval, analyzed via the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture for Toeplitz matrices and supplemented by numerical calculations.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that TDEE remains underexplored; they develop an analytical framework based on the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture and reveal multiple scaling laws across systems and τ regimes, including the τ→0 limit.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify lattice model parameters, numerical system sizes, or finite-size effects; analytical results rely on applicability conditions of the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture; interacting systems are not addressed.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称TDEE此前研究不足；本文给出基于Fisher–Hartwig猜想的解析框架，并揭示不同体系与τ区间下的多种标度律及τ→0极限行为。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体格点模型参数、数值规模与有限尺寸效应；解析结果依赖Fisher–Hartwig猜想的适用条件；未涉及相互作用体系。

papers.title: More physics at the entangling surface: boundary conditions and entanglement in 2d TQFT
papers.abstract: We present a systematic treatment of entanglement in two-dimensional topological quantum field theories (TQFTs). Our approach clarifies the sensitivity of entanglement measures to the cutting maps that implement Hilbert space factorization. Such maps embed the TQFT Hilbert space into a description with potentially more degrees of freedom, and for entanglement to be well defined they must be isometric, i.e., they must preserve the norms of all states. We show that the naïve cutting map based solely upon path integration subject to boundary conditions is not isometric for generic TQFTs. For any 2d TQFT, we give a prescription to construct isometric cutting maps by dressing path integration with suitable edge operators. This allows us to compute entanglement for any state, any bipartition, and any boundary condition. As a consequence, we find a non-integer "ground-state degeneracy" à la Affleck-Ludwig, despite all boundary conditions being gapped. We further show how to reconstruct the partition function of the TQFT at arbitrary genus from the multi-interval Rényi entropies of a single state. For theories with (possibly non-invertible) symmetries, we show that the entanglement entropy of the symmetric ground state can distinguish gapped phases with the same symmetry, without any further knowledge of their vacua, while the entanglement asymmetry of the vacua entropically detects symmetry breaking. We illustrate our formalism with a range of applications, from finite gauge theories to Haagerup gapped phases and infrared phases of adjoint QCD$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于二维拓扑量子场论的形式化推导；研究对象：二维拓扑量子场论（TQFT）中的纠缠，含有限群规范理论、Haagerup 有能隙相与伴随 QCD₂ 红外相
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 朴素切分映射对一般二维 TQFT 非等距；用边缘算符修饰路径积分可构造等距切分映射，从而对任意态、任意二分和任意边界条件计算纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何使二维 TQFT 中的纠缠定义良好，并厘清纠缠量对实现希尔伯特空间分解的切分映射的依赖？
证据与比较：摘要给出形式化论证：仅受边界条件约束的路径积分切分映射一般不保范；构造性处方以边缘算符修饰路径积分得到等距映射；由此得到非整数 Affleck-Ludwig 型“基态简并”，并可由单态多区间 Rényi 熵重构任意亏格配分函数。
papers.method_zh: 系统处理二维 TQFT 的纠缠：检验切分映射的等距性，用边缘算符修饰路径积分构造等距切分映射，并借助多区间 Rényi 熵与纠缠不对称性进行分析。

english_guide.finding: The naïve cutting map based solely on path integration subject to boundary conditions is not isometric for generic 2d TQFTs; dressing path integration with suitable edge operators yields isometric cutting maps, enabling entanglement computation for any state, any bipartition and any boundary condition.
english_guide.question: How can entanglement be well defined in 2d TQFTs, and how do entanglement measures depend on the cutting maps that implement Hilbert space factorization?
english_guide.evidence: Formal arguments that the boundary-condition path-integral cutting map fails to preserve norms; a constructive prescription with edge operators; a non-integer Affleck-Ludwig-like "ground-state degeneracy"; reconstruction of the partition function at arbitrary genus from multi-interval Rényi entropies of a single state.
english_guide.method: Systematic treatment of entanglement in 2d TQFTs: testing isometry of cutting maps, constructing isometric cutting maps by dressing path integration with edge operators, and using multi-interval Rényi entropies and entanglement asymmetry.
english_guide.novelty: The authors claim a prescription to construct isometric cutting maps for any 2d TQFT, a non-integer "ground-state degeneracy", reconstruction of the partition function from entanglement, and entanglement-based distinction of gapped phases with the same symmetry.
english_guide.limitations: Restricted to the formal 2d TQFT framework; the abstract does not specify lattice realizations, numerical checks or higher-dimensional extensions; the RSS snippet may be truncated and the full text was not read.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者声称给出任意二维 TQFT 构造等距切分映射的处方，并据此发现非整数“基态简并”、由纠缠重构配分函数，以及用纠缠区分相同对称性的有能隙相。

papers.title: Tripartite nonlocal magic from reflected and negativity spectra
papers.abstract: A tripartite pure state is local-unitary equivalent to a stabilizer state if and only if its marginal, reflected, and negativity spectra (up to signs) are flat. These conditions are quantified using anti-flatness, giving a diagnostic of tripartite nonlocal magic that is computable and experimentally measurable using randomized measurements. In non-abelian quantum doubles, it appears only when the triple points of the tripartition lie on plaquettes. In random tensor networks, it appears exactly when the entanglement wedge of two boundary regions connects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于谱平坦性判据与随机测量方案；研究对象：三分纯态、非阿贝尔量子双模型、随机张量网络
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三分纯态为稳定子态当且仅当边缘、反射与负性谱（至符号）平坦；用反平坦度可量化三分非局域魔法。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何可计算且可实验测量地诊断三分非局域魔法，并刻画其在具体模型与网络中的出现条件。
证据与比较：摘要给出谱平坦的充要条件陈述；指出非阿贝尔量子双模型中仅当三分点位于plaquette时出现；随机张量网络中恰在两个边界区域纠缠楔连通时出现。
papers.method_zh: 以边缘谱、反射谱与负性谱（reflected and negativity spectra）的反平坦度（anti-flatness）作判据，并用随机测量（randomized measurements）测量。

papers.title: A domain-specific atomistic model for Earth's core materials
papers.abstract: Understanding Earth's core requires accurate descriptions of multicomponent iron alloys under extreme conditions. Here, we develop the Earth's Core Atomistic Model (ECAM) for Fe-Ni-S-Si-O-C-H alloys through sampling with a foundational atomistic model, targeted ab initio simulations, and iterative exploration. A compact dataset selected from nearly half a million configurations is consistently labeled using high-accuracy first-principles calculations and used to train a lightweight model. The model explicitly includes thermal electronic contributions and runs nearly two orders of magnitude faster than the original foundational model. ECAM corrects artifacts in the foundational model's description of core materials and reproduces the density, seismic velocity, Gibbs free energy, and phase diagrams of Fe and binary alloys in agreement with previous ab initio calculations. ECAM is expected to enable more realistic modeling of chemical partitioning and crystallization in Earth's core. Our workflow also provides a practical route from foundational-model sampling to efficient domain-specific simulation.

papers.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Predict Atomic Oxygen Erosion of Polymers in Low Earth Orbit
papers.abstract: Low Earth orbit (LEO), home to most active satellites, is projected to undergo a debris-fragmentation cascade known as Kessler Syndrome. In light of this eventuality, it is imperative to maximize the operational lifetime of LEO satellites. Instrumental to this goal is the development of next-generation polymeric materials with improved resistance to atomic oxygen (AO) erosion. Because genuine LEO exposure experiments are prohibitively expensive and LEO conditions are difficult to reproduce in the laboratory, data-driven approaches offer a promising alternative for accelerating materials discovery. Here, we develop a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) based on OpenAI's GPT-4o to predict the AO erosion yield ($E_y$) of polymers using a curated dataset of 201 measurements compiled from multiple NASA LEO exposure missions. The model achieves an order of magnitude error (OME) of 0.154 and a log-scaled coefficient of determination (log-$R^2$) of 0.719, outperforming conventional machine learning approaches while eliminating the need for extensive feature engineering. Notably, incorporating macroscopic descriptors such as film thickness and layering did not improve predictive performance, suggesting that AO erosion is governed primarily by chemical and environmental variables rather than bulk structural characteristics. This finding underscores the importance of chemically informed polymer design in developing materials with improved AO resistance, while demonstrating the ability of modern LLMs to effectively extract chemically meaningful relationships even when data is limited. Beyond its predictive accuracy, the proposed framework provides a scalable platform for rapidly screening candidate polymers, reducing reliance on costly spaceflight experiments.

papers.title: EoSAlign: An Open-Source Software for Calculating, Comparing, and Aligning Pressure Under Extreme Conditions
papers.abstract: Accurate pressure determination is essential in high pressure experiments. Inconsistencies among pressure scales limit direct comparisons and contribute to uncertainty in measured properties, such as, phase boundaries, melting conditions, and thermodynamic models, especially above 100 GPa where existing scales diverge by >10 GPa. EoSAlign, an open-source software, can calculate, compare, and align pressures using a range of published calibrations. EoSAlign calculates pressure from experimental measurements (such as volume (A^3), Raman shift (cm^-1), or luminescence peak position (nm)) and it can be used to compare pressure values from different pressure standards. Using EoSAlign, we fit and align the bridgmanite and post-perovskite equations of state to a common scale, enabling us to reduce pressure scale related differences. EoSAlign can be applied to any high pressure data analysis to compare experimental results, improve consistency between studies, and advance our understanding of planetary interiors and high pressure physics.

papers.title: An Idealized Model of Buoyant Gas Spreading and Silt Release beneath Rough Cave Ceilings
papers.abstract: Gas exhaled by open-circuit divers collects under the ceilings of submerged caves, migrates along the rock, and dislodges loose silt that then falls through the passage, a process that cave divers call percolation. This study develops an idealized model of the process. Buoyant gas under a self-affine rough ceiling is treated as a quasi-static sequence of pools that fill to their spill points, release gas that climbs to the next high point, and merge where their levels meet. Moving contact lines strip silt from the rock, and the released silt settles as a spectrum of grain sizes that reduces the distance at which a diver can see. The computation agrees exactly with an independent depression-filling algorithm, conserves gas volume to round-off, and reproduces the known exponents of invasion percolation in its capillary limit. A balance between the relief of the ceiling and its dip defines a pool scale that organizes where gas collects, and the area covered by gas from a single source grows more slowly than the volume supplied, as predicted by the self-affine geometry. The cutoff at the pool scale is soft, so large pools persist on steeper ceilings than the scale alone would suggest. In a reference passage, the lead diver of a team releases far more silt than the diver behind, and a team releases far less than the sum of its members acting alone, because the lead diver fills the pools and strips the paths that later divers reuse. This ordering holds across every detachment efficiency and ceiling geometry tested. Visibility toward the exit at eye level continues to decline for an hour or more after a team has passed, as fine silt descends from a nearly opaque layer beneath the ceiling. Absolute silt masses and sighting ranges depend on quantities that have not been measured in caves, and the results are best read as scaling relations and comparisons between scenarios.

papers.title: Tetragonal-to-orthorhombic distortion in CeRh$_{2}$As$_{2}$
papers.abstract: CeRh$_{2}$As$_{2}$ is best known for its two superconducting phases, which are observed when a magnetic field is applied along the $c$ axis of its tetragonal unit cell. The emergence of superconductivity, with $T_{c} \approx 0.31$K, is preceded by an ordered state (phase I), with an ordering temperature $T_{0} \approx 0.46$K. The precise nature of the order parameter in phase I is still unknown, although evidence of dipolar ordering was found. To investigate a possible symmetry breaking at $T_{\textrm{0}}$, we conducted longitudinal thermal-expansion measurements along the crystallographic [100], [010], [110], and [1$\overline{1}$0] directions on a single-crystalline sample cut into an octagonal shape. Our results demonstrate the breaking of the fourfold in-plane symmetry below $T_{\textrm{0}}$, evidencing a small tetragonal-to-orthorhombic distortion (orthorhombicity $δ\sim 10^{-7}$). The breaking of the tetragonal symmetry at $T_{\textrm{0}}$ might imply that the superconducting order parameter that develops within phase I cannot be multi-component. More generally, the distortion places restrictions on the possible order parameters for phase I.

papers.title: Enhancing valley splitting in Si/SiGe Wiggle Well quantum dots through integrated stressor-gate architectures
papers.abstract: Engineering large and reproducible valley splittings is essential for the scalable operation of silicon spin qubits. In Si/SiGe quantum dot devices, valley splitting arises predominantly from atomic-scale disorder and is therefore inherently random, motivating approaches that introduce a large deterministic contribution. Strain-assisted Wiggle Wells provide a route to deterministic valley splitting by combining an oscillatory Ge concentration in the Si well with shear strain; however, generating the required strain in a manner compatible with large-scale architectures remains a challenge. Here, we propose patterned stressed thin films as a scalable approach for generating shear strain in the quantum well of Si/SiGe quantum dot devices. Finite-element simulations show that compressively stressed TiN films can generate shear strains exceeding 0.1% at the quantum well, sufficient for deterministic valley splittings of hundreds of $μ\text{eV}$ in strain-assisted Wiggle Wells. We show that this strain can extend across multiple quantum dots and is maintained in realistic gate geometries, providing a fabrication-compatible approach for scaling deterministic valley splitting to quantum dot arrays.

papers.title: High Pressure Material Phase Identification with Gaussian Kernel Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Phase identification is a computational task involving the classification of material structure using the positions of atoms. Using data from Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, our task is to identify the material phase of a set of atoms, based on how the simulations predict their positioning relative to each other. By leveraging existing research on mechanistic neural network theory, particularly Neural Tangent Kernels (NTK), we develop a new and efficient method for classifying simulated material samples. Our method involves defining a set of "atom detectors" that are given positions around the origin in cartesian coordinates. The sum of Gaussians centered at each atom is calculated at each atom detector, and is used as the input to a neural network. We present theoretical and experimental evidence to show that this method is highly effective and efficient at the task. Our method obtains better or similar accuracy scores to commonly used methods while having a major computational speedup.

papers.title: Ambient-pressure superconductivity in bulk single crystals of La$_5$Ni$_4$O$_{10}$
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in the Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates has so far been confined either to multilayer compounds under high pressure or to square-planar infinite-layer-type films stabilized by epitaxial strain. Here we report the high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) growth of bulk single crystals of the quadruple-layer RP nickelate La$_5$Ni$_4$O$_{13}$ ($n=4$) and reproduce the quintuple-layer La$_6$Ni$_5$O$_{16}$ ($n=5$) synthesis, two members of the series that had previously been accessible only as thin films. Topotactic reduction of La$_5$Ni$_4$O$_{13}$ single crystals with CaH$_2$ yields the square-planar phase La$_5$Ni$_4$O$_{10}$, which we show to be a bulk, ambient-pressure superconductor with $T_\mathrm{c}^\mathrm{onset} \approx 18\,\mathrm{K}$, a shielding fraction above 60\%, and a specific-heat jump that confirms a bulk pairing transition. All crystals show besides superconductivity a coexistence with a density-wave or metal-insulator transition. The upper critical field shows a small anisotropy, $γ\approx 2.4$, which remains finite as $T \to T_c$, indicating three-dimensional superconductivity with substantial coupling between the four-layer blocks. These results identify the square-planar nickelates $R_{n+1}$Ni$_n$O$_{2n+2}$ as a bulk platform in which the layer number alone tunes the nickel valence into the superconducting regime, without chemical substitution, pressure, or epitaxial constraint.

papers.title: Universal semiclassical drift velocity of magnetic edge channels
papers.abstract: Magnetic edge channels, arising at the edge of a two-dimensional electron gas in a magnetic field, are topologically protected and propagate unidirectionally along the edge. Their group velocities at the Fermi level, being averaged harmonically, result in drift velocity, which is related to the edge density of states, quantum capacitance, and the velocity of edge magnetoplasmons. Using semiclassical quantization of electron skipping orbits, we show that the drift velocity equals 1/2 of the electron Fermi velocity in the limit of a large number of edge channels crossing the Fermi level. This result, being universal for a hard edge and for isotropic dispersion, is checked numerically for massive electrons and for massless electrons in graphene. The drift velocity at smooth electrostatically defined edges lacks such universality. In the case of anisotropic dispersion, the semiclassical drift velocity at the hard edge reduces to a coordinate-velocity correlation along the cyclotron orbit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论为主，辅以数值验证；基于半经典量子化与数值检验。；研究对象：磁场中二维电子气边缘的磁性边缘通道，包括硬边界与平滑静电边界，以及石墨烯中的无质量电子。

papers.title: Finite temperature and pressure structural relaxations including zero-point motion and anharmonicity
papers.abstract: At finite temperature and pressure, the equilibrium structure of a crystal minimizes the Gibbs free energy rather than the static Born-Oppenheimer energy. We present WARP (Wyckoff-constrained Anharmonic Relaxations at Pressure and temperature), a symmetry-constrained, variable-cell relaxation based on the stochastic temperature-dependent effective potential method, including anharmonicity and zero-point motion. Every position update is projected onto Wyckoff positions and every strain onto symmetric strains, so a relaxation can raise the symmetry but never lower it. For aluminum, the thermal expansion follows measurements at cryogenic temperatures, including the quantum plateau below 50 K. For lanthanum hydrides at megabar pressures, equations of state agree with phonon-based and path-integral calculations, and LaH$_{10}$ relaxes from its rhombohedral static minimum to the observed cubic phase, also with a machine-learned potential fine-tuned on 150 supercells. For brucite, Mg(OD)$_2$, lattice parameters, bond distances and thermal expansion agree with neutron diffraction, and the O-D isotope effect is captured.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算为主，摘要提及与实验测量及路径积分计算对比；研究对象：铝、高压镧氢化物（LaH10）及氢氧镁石 Mg(OD)2

证据与比较：铝的热膨胀与低温测量一致，包括 50 K 以下量子平台；兆巴压力下镧氢化物状态方程与声子及路径积分计算一致；LaH10 由菱方静态极小弛豫到观测立方相；Mg(OD)2 晶格参数、键长与热膨胀与中子衍射一致，并捕捉 O-D 同位素效应。

papers.title: Catalysis-induced phase separation of enzymes via diffusivity contrast
papers.abstract: Catalysis can drive phase separation by coupling local chemical composition to molecular transport, even in the absence of attractive interactions. Here, we demonstrate such catalysis-induced phase separation in a microscopic particle-based model of enzymes catalyzing the interconversion of substrate and product molecules with different diffusivities. We derive an analytical instability criterion in the dilute limit, showing that a homogeneous mixture becomes unstable when the nonequilibrium chemical drive and the diffusivity contrast are sufficiently large, and the substrate and product concentration exceeds a threshold set by the enzyme volume. Brownian-dynamics simulations confirm the predicted instability and reveal macroscopic coexistence of enzyme-rich and enzyme-poor phases, including in regimes where equilibrium depletion interactions cannot account for demixing. Finally, we show that, upon eliminating the fast chemical degrees of freedom, the reactive ternary mixture maps onto an effective binary mixture nonreciprocal interactions. Our results establish an explicit microscopic mechanism for catalysis-induced phase separation and connect chemically driven phase separation to the physics of motility-regulated and nonreciprocal matter.

papers.title: Out-of-plane interference effects in the angle-resolved photoemission of epitaxial graphene
papers.abstract: The epitaxial growth of monolayer graphene by Si sublimation of 6H-SiC(0001) is one of the most effective ways of producing large-scale monocrystalline graphene samples of high quality. However, graphene is left interacting with a reconstructed carbon buffer layer known as zerolayer graphene (ZLG) and the SiC substrate underneath. Beyond the mere creation of Dirac cone replicas, the effect of this interaction on photoemission measurements is poorly understood. We utilized synchrotron radiation for photon-energy-dependent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) to investigate the complex final-state interactions of photoelectrons within the heterostructure of monolayer graphene, ZLG, and SiC. We identify multiple resonances in the photoemission intensity of the Dirac cone as a function of photon energy that originate from interlayer interference, confirmed with a multiple scattering model. We also demonstrate for the first time that the relative intensity of the replica bands induced by the $(6\sqrt{3} \times 6\sqrt{3})\text{R}30^\circ$ reconstruction scales with the electron kinetic energy. Finally, we resolved four nondispersing electronic states, which originate from the ZLG. Our findings show that the three-dimensional (3D) structure of SiC and ZLG manifests itself in the photoemission from two-dimensional (2D) epitaxial graphene. By revealing how 3D substrate architecture dictates the photoemission of a 2D layer, this work establishes a crucial framework for investigating the electronic structure of complex heterostructures via ARPES.

papers.title: Spin Shuttling Through Quantum-Dot Based Chiral Molecular Bridges: Gauge Constraints, Holonomy, and Quantum Gates
papers.abstract: Chiral molecular bridges between silicon quantum dots can provide novel two-qubit entangling resources via the chirality-induced spin-selectivity (CISS) effect. We evaluate this using Makhlin invariants. Modeling a phase-coherent bridge as an $\mathrm{SU}(2)$-valued hopping between two spins, a Schrieffer-Wolff reduction yields a twisted exchange interaction $J \mathbf{S}_1 \cdot \mathbf{R} \mathbf{S}_2$, whose Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya and symmetric anisotropic parts are fixed by a single bridge angle $α$. Using the Kaplan-Shekhtman-Entin-Wohlman-Aharony (KSEA) gauge argument, we prove this interaction is locally equivalent to isotropic exchange; thus, a single chiral bond does not constitute a new entangling class. Breaking this gauge symmetry reveals genuine chiral utility: chiral exchange converts a uniform transverse field into a synthetic gradient, bringing the two-qubit propagator within $7\times10^{-4}$ of the CNOT class in invariant space 4.7 times faster than an equivalent orthogonal gradient. Shuttling a spin through bridges with non-collinear axes implements a non-Abelian $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ holonomy, yielding rotationally non-reciprocal transport and closed-loop geometric gates that suppress dynamical-phase noise to second order. To address the unsettled microscopic origin of CISS, we introduce a unified transport channel combining coherent rotation, a direction-reversing spin filter, and pointer-basis dephasing. This model obeys an exact $\tanh$ composition law for pumped polarization and a closed-form transverse decay law, yielding four observables that experimentally over-determine the bridge's coherent fraction $F_c$. Finally, we quantify silicon-specific hardware constraints, establishing the Landau-Zener valley-adiabaticity window ($E_v \geq 2.1\sqrt{\hbar v}$) and charge-noise limit ($σ_J/J \leq 3\%$) required for $99\%$ gate fidelity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于模型推导与数值评估；研究对象：硅量子点间手性分子桥中的自旋输运与两比特门
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单根手性键经KSEA规范论证与各向同性交换局域等价，不构成新纠缠类；破坏规范对称性后手性交换可将均匀横向场转为合成梯度，加速CNOT类传播子并实现非阿贝尔SU(2) holonomy几何门。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：手性分子桥的CISS效应能否为硅量子点提供新型两比特纠缠资源，以及其微观起源与硬件约束如何。
证据与比较：用Makhlin不变量评估传播子；手性交换使两比特传播子在不变空间4中距CNOT类7×10^-4，比等效正交梯度快4.7倍；给出tanh组合律与横向衰减闭式解，四个观测量过定相干分数F_c；确立E_v≥2.1√(ℏv)与σ_J/J≤3%以实现99%保真度。
papers.method_zh: 将相位相干桥建模为SU(2)跳跃，经Schrieffer-Wolff约化得扭曲交换；用KSEA规范论证、Makhlin不变量、holonomy分析与统一输运通道模型。
papers.first_affiliation: Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, India

papers.title: Renewal Bias in Parallel Simulations of Absorbing Processes
papers.abstract: Asynchronous parallel simulations of stochastic processes with absorbing states can exhibit systematic sampling bias when trajectory durations depend on their eventual absorbing outcomes. Workers that continuously restart upon absorption preferentially record rapidly terminating trajectories within a fixed computational budget, distorting the observed ensemble statistics. We investigate this effect using a minimal renewal model with two absorbing states and state-dependent exponential durations. Renewal theory yields exact expressions for the expected number and composition of completed trajectories, showing that the resulting bias decreases algebraically with execution time but persists as the number of parallel workers increases at fixed budget. We compare continuous sampling with First-Trajectory Filtering, which retains only the initial trajectory attempted by each worker. Although finite execution deadlines introduce residual censoring bias, this bias decreases exponentially with the computational budget. An analytical mean-squared error calculation reveals budget-dependent crossover worker allocations beyond which First-Trajectory Filtering becomes more accurate despite collecting fewer trajectories. We also examine the limitations of statistical inference under severe censoring when the absorbing-state probabilities and characteristic durations are unknown. Finally, simulations of the Axelrod model near its nonequilibrium transition demonstrate the preferential sampling of rapidly absorbing fragmented configurations, illustrating the relevance of the renewal mechanism in a spatially interacting system. Our results show that increasing computational throughput does not necessarily improve statistical accuracy and highlight the importance of accounting for trajectory-duration heterogeneity in parallel simulations of absorbing processes.

papers.title: Ground-state phase diagram of the spin-1/2 Heisenberg zigzag ladder with anisotropic $Γ$ term revisited
papers.abstract: We study the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet with an anisotropic $Γ$ term on a zigzag ladder, which can be exactly mapped to the spin-1/2 XYZ zigzag ladder by a spin rotation. This model has recently attracted considerable interest as an effective model for the quasi-one-dimensional magnetic semiconductor YbCuS$_2$. For the model, the ground-state phase diagram was previously proposed by Saito and Hotta [Phys. Rev. Lett. 132, 166701 (2024); Phys. Rev. B 110, 024409 (2024)]. We systematically reexamine the phase diagram through complementary numerical and analytical approaches, including exact diagonalization, the density-matrix renormalization group method, and low-energy effective theories. We thereby demonstrate that when the anisotropic $Γ$ term is present, the model exhibits the Néel, dimer, ferromagnetic, and double-Néel phases, all of which have a finite excitation gap. The gapless Tomonaga-Luttinger-liquid (TLL) phase appears only in the isotropic case where the $Γ$ term is absent. We also confirm that the transitions between the Néel and dimer phases and between the Néel and ferromagnetic phases are continuous transitions governed by Gaussian criticality with central charge $c=1$. The TLL parameter characterizing the critical states at the Gaussian transitions is estimated numerically.

papers.title: Higher tensor network states in two spatial dimensions: fundamental theorem for open boundary conditions
papers.abstract: We introduce a class of two-dimensional tensor network states obtained by categorifying matrix product states. This procedure leads us to consider bond spaces provided by a 2-vector space associated with the 2-cells of the underlying lattice. Tensor network representations are then defined as module categories over the free monoidal category on a monoidal signature encoding the lattice geometry. We prove a fundamental theorem stating that two representations generating the same states with suitable open boundary conditions are equivalent as module categories. Finally, we introduce a notion of 2-injectivity, a categorified analogue of the injectivity condition for matrix product states.

papers.title: A Hierarchy of Fast and Strong Signatures for Vertex Orbits
papers.abstract: The defining features of a physical system are its symmetries and its invariants. For a network, the symmetries are the automorphisms, and the invariants are the vertex orbits they define. Two vertices of a graph may appear structurally indistinguishable without being interchangeable under any graph automorphism. Distinguishing apparent similarity from genuine symmetry lies at the heart of the vertex-orbit partition problem. In this work, we develop a hierarchy of increasingly expressive, automorphism-invariant signatures that draw on the spectral properties of the graph Laplacian and the Dirac operator to reveal subtle structural differences. Guided by a sequence of counterexamples, we progressively strengthen these signatures, ultimately incorporating probing techniques, which are temporary structural perturbations, that expose the hidden distinctions in the original unperturbed graph. We evaluate our approach across diverse benchmark families, recovering exact orbit partitions in challenging instances, including graphs that resist low-dimensional Weisfeiler--Leman refinement. We also examine the computational and numerical limitations of our constructions, distinguishing empirical success from theoretical completeness. Our findings highlight the potential of spectral and probing-based methods for uncovering the structural distinctions that define vertex orbit.

papers.title: Compensation Domain Walls in Ferrimagnets as Spin-Torque Oscillator Candidates
papers.abstract: Spin-torque nano-oscillators are promising nanoscale microwave sources, yet their performance is often limited by narrow operational ranges and sensitivity to device parameters. Here, we numerically investigate the dynamics of compensation domain walls in ferrimagnetic systems driven by spin-transfer torque as a microwave source candidate. These walls arise in structures with adjacent regions of different compensation character, where the competition between exchange and Zeeman energies under an applied magnetic field stabilizes a distinct magnetic texture. We demonstrate steady current-driven rotation of compensation domain walls over a broad range of current densities within the model. To elucidate the underlying mechanism, we develop a collective-coordinate model and derive an analytical expression for the oscillation frequency, which quantitatively reproduces the dependence on current and magnetic field observed in micromagnetic simulations. Our results identify compensation domain walls as a candidate platform for tunable spin-torque nano-oscillators with intrinsic field-induced confinement.

papers.title: GibbScope: interactive calculation and visualization of phase diagrams in the browser
papers.abstract: Phase diagrams are a constant work in progress as Gibbs-energy models are fitted, revised, and disputed in the light of an endless stream of experimental and computational data. Yet, phase diagrams are still largely communicated as static figures, in much the same way as a century ago. We present GibbScope, a web-based framework for interactive calculation and visualization of binary phase diagrams. Written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly, the new CALPHAD engine recomputes a complete phase diagram in the browser in a fraction of a second with zero installation on the user or server side. The high speed allows new ways of interacting with phase diagrams and underlying assessments. Validation against well-established CALPHAD software shows agreement to within 0.01 K for invariant temperatures and within 1e-6 for tie-line compositions for most databases. GibbScope offers interactive CALPHAD parameter adjustments, overlays of different assessments and point-by-point misfit to experimental data, which makes the diagram a live, working object. In addition, GibbScope provides convenient access to 2745 thermodynamic databases from the SGTE collection (Hallstedt, 2025) and their live adjustment. For over 1200 of these databases, all phases are modeled in full with the current implementation.

papers.title: Harmonic origin of local symmetry breaking in PbTe revealed using machine-learned potentials
papers.abstract: We use machine-learned interatomic potentials combined with higher-order interatomic force constant models to show that finite-range polar correlations in PbTe are driven by long-range harmonic interactions rather than lattice anharmonicity. Our molecular dynamics simulations reveal a spatial polar correlation range exceeding 50 Å at low temperatures and decreasing with increasing temperature. Selective interatomic force constant mapping demonstrates that crystal anharmonicity usually associated with the formation of polar nanoregions suppresses polar correlations. Instead, long-range harmonic interactions extending to 13 Å are necessary to reproduce the spatial coherence of local dipoles. In reciprocal space, these extended harmonic interactions correspond to high curvature of the transverse optical (TO) phonon branch at the $Γ$ point. Comparison with isostructural NaCl connects these extended interactions to local underscreening of predominantly Coulombic forces. Our results provide a key microscopic description of finite-range polar correlations and a framework for understanding local symmetry breaking in centrosymmetric materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；基于机器学习势与分子动力学模拟；研究对象：PbTe（碲化铅）及其同构材料 NaCl
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PbTe 中有限程极性关联由延伸至 13 Å 的长程谐波相互作用驱动，而非通常认为的晶格非谐性。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：PbTe 中局域对称破缺与有限程极性关联的微观起源是什么：是晶格非谐性还是长程谐波相互作用？
证据与比较：分子动力学模拟显示低温下空间极性关联范围超过 50 Å，并随温度升高而减小；选择性力常数映射表明非谐性抑制极性关联，需延伸至 13 Å 的谐波相互作用才能重现局域偶极的空间相干性；倒空间中对应 Γ 点 TO 声子支的高曲率。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习原子间势结合高阶原子间力常数模型与分子动力学模拟，并进行选择性原子间力常数映射及与 NaCl 的对比。

english_guide.finding: Finite-range polar correlations in PbTe are driven by long-range harmonic interactions extending to 13 Å, not by lattice anharmonicity.
english_guide.question: What is the microscopic origin of local symmetry breaking and finite-range polar correlations in PbTe: lattice anharmonicity or long-range harmonic interactions?
english_guide.evidence: Molecular dynamics simulations show a spatial polar correlation range exceeding 50 Å at low temperatures that decreases with increasing temperature; selective interatomic force constant mapping shows anharmonicity suppresses polar correlations, and harmonic interactions extending to 13 Å are needed to reproduce spatial coherence of local dipoles, corresponding to high curvature of the TO phonon branch at the Γ point.
english_guide.method: Machine-learned interatomic potentials combined with higher-order interatomic force constant models and molecular dynamics simulations, selective interatomic force constant mapping, and comparison with isostructural NaCl.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state the results provide a key microscopic description of finite-range polar correlations and a framework for understanding local symmetry breaking in centrosymmetric materials.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify simulation temperature range, potential accuracy, or applicability conditions; conclusions are computational with no experimental validation provided.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称其提供了有限程极性关联的关键微观描述，以及理解中心对称材料中局域对称破缺的框架。

papers.title: Spin-valve effect through electrostatic coupling
papers.abstract: We propose a spin-valve effect in which an insulating magnetic van der Waals multilayer controls the conductance of an adjacent non-magnetic conductor by electrostatic coupling, without transport-electrons entering the magnetic layers. The coupling is induced by the variations of the electronic structure when the relative orientation of the magnetization of adjacent monolayers changes from parallel to antiparallel, modifying both the dielectric constant and band alignment. We consider two types of coupling and device concepts: charge transfer to a graphene monolayer and capacitive coupling in a single-electron transistor. We use density functional calculations to assess the magnitude of the effect in various materials, including CrI$_3$, CrBr$_3$, CrCl$_3$ and NiBr$_2$. We predict magnetoresistance ratios in the range of 1.14-1.20 for the charge-transfer device and up to $10^3$ in the single-electron transistor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；依据为密度泛函计算预测器件效应；研究对象：绝缘磁性范德华多层（CrI₃、CrBr₃、CrCl₃、NiBr₂）与相邻非磁导体构成的耦合体系
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种自旋阀效应：绝缘磁性范德华多层通过静电耦合调控相邻非磁导体电导，而输运电子不进入磁性层。

研究问题：能否在不让输运电子进入磁性层的前提下，利用磁性层磁化取向变化经静电耦合调控相邻非磁导体电导。
证据与比较：摘要给出密度泛函计算预测的磁阻比：电荷转移器件为1.14–1.20，单电子晶体管最高达10³；并指出耦合源于相邻单层磁化由平行转为反平行时介电常数与能带对齐的变化。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函计算，评估CrI₃、CrBr₃、CrCl₃、NiBr₂等材料中两类耦合的效应大小。

english_guide.question: Can the conductance of an adjacent non-magnetic conductor be controlled by electrostatic coupling from an insulating magnetic van der Waals multilayer, without transport electrons entering the magnetic layers?

papers.title: Nonlinear integral equations for stress-controlled rheology: Collocation methods for Volterra equations with functional kernels
papers.abstract: We present a class of numerical collocation methods to solve a typical inverse problem that arises in the stress-controlled rheology of complex fluids with pronounced history-dependent response, where the relation between stress and flow rate is given by an integral constitutive equation as the material law. We demonstrate the method by calculating the creep response of a nontrivial model of a shear-thinning viscoelastic fluid where a stress overshoot in rate-controlled startup flow leads to ``sudden yielding'' in stress-controlled creep. Our method is able to address the long-time behavior of the model, distinguishing the amorphous solid from the stress-induced yielded fluid, and from the in-between case of infinite deformation that never achieves a stationary shear rate (proper creep). To this end, we implement a method with flexible time-stepping, and prove uniqueness of the solution and convergence of the methods for a broad class of highly viscoelastic non-linear rheological laws in integral form.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：数值计算与理论分析，含收敛性证明；研究对象：应力控制流变学中具有历史依赖响应的复杂流体，示例为剪切变稀黏弹性流体模型

papers.title: Contrasting one- and two-particle excitations in cuprate strange metals
papers.abstract: In unconventional superconductivity, the pairing mechanism remains one of the central unresolved problems in solid-state physics. Moreover, the normal state shows strong deviations from conventional Fermi-liquid behavior, most notably a scattering rate that is linear in energy and temperature. Here we study the momentum dependence of the energy and damping of collective excitations in optimally doped cuprates in the normal state. In particular, we analyze existing Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS) data of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 [Phys. Rev. B 44, 7155 (1991)] and new analogous optical plasmon data of Bi2Sr2Ca2Cu3O10. Furthermore, we reanalyze similar Resonant Inelastic Xray Scattering (RIXS) acoustic plasmon data [Phys. Rev. R 6, 043184 (2024)] of La1.84Sr0.16CuO4 and La1.84Ce0.16CuO4. We contrast these two-particle excitation results with one-particle excitations measured by Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES). Most of the plasmon behavior can be described well by combined self-energies of a hole and an electron. The dispersion of optical plasmons at high energy is only weakly determined by correlation effects, indicating resilient quasiparticles. The damping of the optical plasmons at low energy, however, is strongly influenced by the reduced scattering rates described in the marginal Fermi liquid model for "strange-metal" behavior. In addition, the same model describes the linear-in-energy damping of acoustic plasmons. Contrary to some theoretical predictions, we see no overdamped optical plasmons below the classical Lindhard critical wave vector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论分析，基于已有实验数据的重新分析与模型对比；研究对象：最佳掺杂铜氧化物正常态：Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8、Bi2Sr2Ca2Cu3O10、La1.84Sr0.16CuO4、La1.84Ce0.16CuO4
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双粒子等离激元激发可由空穴与电子自能组合描述，其高能色散受关联效应影响弱，低能阻尼受边际费米液体散射率强烈影响。

研究问题：铜氧化物奇异金属正常态中，双粒子集体激发的动量依赖能量与阻尼能否用单粒子自能及边际费米液体模型统一描述？

english_guide.question: Can the momentum-dependent energy and damping of two-particle collective excitations in cuprate strange metals be unified with one-particle self-energies and the marginal Fermi liquid model?

papers.title: Quantum benchmarks for magnetic energies and transition temperatures
papers.abstract: Predicting magnetic ordering temperatures requires accurate exchange interactions and an appropriate treatment of spin thermodynamics. Here we assess these requirements through complementary quantum Monte Carlo benchmarks. For five insulating antiferromagnets, we compare ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic energy differences from diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) and density functional theory with references reconstructed from inelastic neutron scattering (INS) exchanges. DMC underestimates these references but achieves a mean absolute error comparable to the best-performing functionals tested. Separately, we directly test the previously proposed (S+1)/S rescaling of classical Monte Carlo temperatures against quantum stochastic series expansion simulations for 17 compounds using corresponding INS-derived Heisenberg Hamiltonians. Rescaling reduces the mean absolute classical-quantum temperature difference from 81.7 to 8.2 K, with a mean absolute percentage difference of 5.9 %. These results establish a direct quantum benchmark for the rescaling within the tested models and emphasize that improvements in electronic magnetic energy scales should be accompanied by attention to quantum spin thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究；基于量子蒙特卡罗基准对比；研究对象：五种绝缘反铁磁体及17种化合物的海森堡哈密顿量
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DMC低估由INS交换重构的磁能参考值，误差与最佳泛函相当；(S+1)/S重标度使经典-量子转变温度平均绝对差从81.7 K降至8.2 K。

研究问题：如何用量子基准检验磁交换能计算与经典蒙特卡罗转变温度重标度的可靠性？

papers.title: Quotient Index for Symmetry-Protected Zeros and the Tenfold Way in Mackey's Construction of Super Corepresentations
papers.abstract: Symmetries that anticommute with a Hamiltonian can protect zero modes by obstructing their removal through symmetry-compatible perturbations. We formulate this obstruction as a quotient of the additive group of symmetry representations by the image of the map that forgets a compatible representation grading. To compute the quotient, we use Mackey's method to construct all irreducible super corepresentations of finite graded symmetry groups, allowing antiunitary operations and projective factor systems. Starting from the unitary Hamiltonian-preserving normal subgroup, this construction yields two complex and ten real structural types, characterized by residual Altland--Zirnbauer symmetry algebras. The residual and induced graded modules have isomorphic graded commutants, and their represented symmetry algebras share a graded Morita class that is super opposite to that of the commutant. We derive character criteria that identify these types. Exhaustive enumeration of the restriction relations gives independent sector contributions $0$, $Z$, or $Z_2$, with only integer factors in the purely unitary case. In the finite semisimple setting, the complete index vanishes if and only if all zero modes can be lifted by a symmetry-compatible perturbation. Applications to one-dimensional end states and interpolation cylinders of disordered boundary Dirac theories recover protected multiplet counts and connect the quotient to bulk topology and sigma-model topological terms using bulk--boundary correspondence, texture-index theorems, and fermion-phase calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于有限分级对称群的表示论构造与指标计算；研究对象：反幺正对称性保护的零模、有限分级对称群及其超余表示
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将对称性对零模的阻碍表述为对称表示的加法群对遗忘相容分级的映射像的商，并据此得到两类复结构与十类实结构。

papers.title: Resolving the backbone of multiscale interactions through mutual information rates
papers.abstract: Natural systems are often composed of processes evolving on multiple timescales and coupled through complex interaction networks. Inferring such networks is especially challenging when timescales are widely separated, since resolving the fastest processes while accurately sampling the slowest ones is generally prohibitive. In this work, we propose a framework to reconstruct a multiscale interaction tree by combining a rescaled version of the mutual information rate, its conditional counterpart, and the ordering of timescales. We derive an exact theory for stationary Gaussian processes, finding that these measures identify directly connected processes, with the asymptotic mutual information rate distinguishing fast-to-slow from slow-to-fast couplings. We show that this reconstruction can be achieved from the spectral matrix and illustrate its robustness to finite trajectory lengths, moderate timescale separation, and weak nonlinearities. Our work paves the way for exploiting the presence of multiple timescales in real-world systems as a source of structural identifiability rather than an obstacle to network inference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论为主，含数值验证；依据为推导精确理论并检验有限轨迹稳健性；研究对象：多时间尺度耦合的平稳高斯过程及多尺度相互作用网络
